title.zh: 卷519 列傳三百六 藩部二 敖汉 奈曼 巴林 扎鲁特 阿噜科尔沁 翁牛特 克什克腾 喀尔喀左翼 乌珠穆沁 浩齐特 苏尼特 阿巴噶 阿巴哈纳尔
title.en: Volume 519 Biographies 306: Frontier Dependencies 2: Aohan, Naiman, Baarin, Jarud, Ar Khorchin, Ongniud, Hexigten, Ka Er Ka Zuo Yi, Ujumqin, Horchin, Sunid, Abaga, Abahanar
title.raw: 卷519 列傳三百六 藩部二 敖汉 奈曼 巴林 扎鲁特 阿噜科尔沁 翁牛特 克什克腾 喀尔喀左翼 乌珠穆沁 浩齐特 苏尼特 阿巴噶 阿巴哈纳尔

sentences.zh: 敖漢部，在喜峰口外，至京師千有十里。

translations.literal: The Aohan tribe is beyond Xifeng Pass, one thousand and ten li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Aohan banner lay beyond Xifeng Pass, some 1,010 li from the capital.

sentences.zh: 東西距百六十里，南北距二百八十里。

translations.literal: East to west it measures one hundred sixty li; north to south two hundred eighty li.
translations.idiomatic: It measured 160 li from east to west and 280 li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 東柰曼，西喀喇沁，南土默特，北翁牛特。

translations.literal: To the east is Naiman; to the west Kharchin; to the south Tumed; to the north Ongniud.
translations.idiomatic: Naiman lay to the east, Kharchin to the west, Tumed to the south, and Ongniud to the north.

sentences.zh: 內扎薩克二十四部，自科爾沁、紮賚特、杜爾伯特、郭爾羅斯、喀喇沁、土默特左翼、阿嚕科爾沁、翁牛特、阿巴噶、阿巴哈納爾、四子部落、茂明安、烏喇特外，皆元太祖十五世孫達延車臣汗之裔。

translations.literal: Of the twenty-four Inner Jasak tribes, apart from Khorchin, Jalaid, Durbot, Gorlos, Kharchin, Left Tumed, Ar Khorchin, Ongniud, Abaga, Abahanar, the Fourth Tribe, Minggan, and Urad, all were descendants of Dayan Chesen Khan, the fifteenth-generation grandson of the Yuan founding emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Of the twenty-four Inner Jasak banners, all save Khorchin, Jalaid, Durbot, Gorlos, Kharchin, Left Tumed, Ar Khorchin, Ongniud, Abaga, Abahanar, the Fourth Tribe, Minggan, and Urad traced their descent to Dayan Chesen Khan, fifteenth-generation scion of Genghis Khan.

sentences.zh: 達延車臣汗子十一：長圖嚕博羅特，其嗣為敖漢、柰曼、烏珠穆沁、浩齊特、蘇尼特五部；

translations.literal: Dayan Chesen Khan had eleven sons. The eldest was Tülu Bolot, whose descendants formed the five tribes of Aohan, Naiman, Ujumqin, Khorchin, and Sunid.
translations.idiomatic: Dayan Chesen Khan had eleven sons. His eldest, Tülu Bolot, was ancestor to five banners: Aohan, Naiman, Ujumqin, Khorchin, and Sunid.

sentences.zh: 第三子巴爾蘇博羅特，其嗣為土默特右翼一旗及鄂爾多斯部；

translations.literal: The third son was Bars Bolot, whose descendants formed one banner of Right Tumed and the Ordos tribe.
translations.idiomatic: The third son, Bars Bolot, founded the Right Tumed banner and the Ordos banners.

sentences.zh: 第五子阿爾楚博羅特，其嗣為巴林、紮嚕特二部；

translations.literal: The fifth son was Altai Bolot, whose descendants formed the two tribes of Baarin and Jarud.
translations.idiomatic: The fifth son, Altai Bolot, was ancestor to the Baarin and Jarud banners.

sentences.zh: 第六子鄂齊爾博羅特，其嗣為克什克騰部；

translations.literal: The sixth son was Öchir Bolot, whose descendants formed the Hexigten tribe.
translations.idiomatic: The sixth son, Öchir Bolot, founded the Hexigten banner.

sentences.zh: 第十一子格哷森紮紮賚爾琿台吉，其嗣為喀爾咯左翼、喀爾喀右翼二部；

translations.literal: The eleventh son was Galsangja Jarai Hün Taiji, whose descendants formed the two tribes of Khalkha Left and Khalkha Right.
translations.idiomatic: The eleventh son, Galsangja Jarai Hün Taiji, founded the Left and Right Khalkha banners.

sentences.zh: 餘皆不著。

translations.literal: The rest are not recorded.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining sons are not recorded here.

sentences.zh: 圖嚕博羅特子二：長博第阿喇克，詳烏珠穆沁傳；

translations.literal: Tülu Bolot had two sons. The elder was Boti Alak; see the Ujumqin biography.
translations.idiomatic: Tülu Bolot had two sons. The elder, Boti Alak, is treated in the Ujumqin biography.

sentences.zh: 次納密克，生貝瑪土謝圖。

translations.literal: The younger was Namik, who begot Bema Tushitu.
translations.idiomatic: The younger, Namik, fathered Bema Tushitu.

sentences.zh: 子二：長岱青杜楞，號所部曰敖漢；

translations.literal: He had two sons. The elder was Daiqing Duleng, who styled his tribe Aohan.
translations.idiomatic: He had two sons. The elder, Daiqing Duleng, gave his people the name Aohan.

sentences.zh: 次額森偉徵諾顏，詳柰曼傳。

translations.literal: The younger was Esen Wei Zheng Noyan; see the Naiman biography.
translations.idiomatic: The younger, Esen Wei Zheng Noyan, is treated in the Naiman biography.

sentences.zh: 岱青杜楞子索諾木杜棱及塞臣卓哩克圖，初皆服屬於察哈爾。

translations.literal: Daiqing Duleng's sons Sonom Düren and Sechen Jölikitu initially all submitted to Chakhar.
translations.idiomatic: Daiqing Duleng's sons Sonom Düren and Sechen Jölikitu had at first all been subject to Chakhar.

sentences.zh: 以林丹汗不道，天聰元年，偕柰曼部長袞楚克率屬來歸，詔索諾木杜棱居開原，塞臣卓哩克圖還舊牧。

translations.literal: Because Ligdan Khan was unjust, in the first year of Tiancong, together with Naiman chief Günchük he led his people to submit. An edict ordered Sonom Düren to dwell at Kaiyuan and Sechen Jölikitu to return to his old pastures.
translations.idiomatic: When Ligdan Khan proved tyrannical, in Tiancong 1 (1627) he and the Naiman chief Günchük brought their people over to the Qing. Sonom Düren was ordered to settle at Kaiyuan, while Sechen Jölikitu was sent back to his former grazing lands.

sentences.zh: 二年，偕柰曼、巴林、紮嚕特諸台吉剿察哈爾，諭勿妄殺降，嚴汛哨。

translations.literal: In the second year, together with the taijis of Naiman, Baarin, and Jarud he suppressed Chakhar. They were instructed not to kill surrenders wantonly and to strictly maintain guard posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he joined the Naiman, Baarin, and Jarud taijis in campaigning against Chakhar. They were told not to slaughter those who surrendered and to tighten their patrol posts.

sentences.zh: 後索諾木杜棱以私獵哈達、葉赫山罪，議奪開原地。

translations.literal: Later Sonom Düren was charged with privately hunting in the Hada and Yehe mountains, and it was proposed to strip him of his Kaiyuan lands.
translations.idiomatic: Later Sonom Düren was found guilty of unauthorized hunting in the Hada and Yehe mountains, and the court debated confiscating his Kaiyuan holdings.

sentences.zh: 塞臣卓哩克圖卒，子旺第繼為部長。

translations.literal: Sechen Jölikitu died, and his son Wangdi succeeded as tribal chief.
translations.idiomatic: When Sechen Jölikitu died, his son Wangdi succeeded him as banner chief.

sentences.zh: 八年冬，遣大臣赴碩翁科爾定諸籓牧，以紮哈蘇台、囊嘉台為敖漢界。

translations.literal: In the winter of the eighth year, a minister was dispatched to Shüngön Köl to fix the pastures of the frontier tribes. Zhahasu Tai and Nangjia Tai were set as the Aohan boundary.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the eighth year a minister went to Shüngön Köl to demarcate frontier pastures, fixing Zhahasu Tai and Nangjia Tai as the Aohan border.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，詔編所部佐領，設扎薩克，以旺第領之，爵多羅郡王。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde, an edict ordered the organization of zuolings for the tribe, established a jasak, and put Wangdi in charge, enfeoffing him as Prince of the First Rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1 (1636) the banner's zuolings were registered, a jasak was appointed with Wangdi at its head, and he was ennobled as a prince of the first rank.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入山海關，擊流賊李自成。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi, he followed the army through Shanhaiguan and attacked the bandit Li Zicheng.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 (1644) he marched through Shanhaiguan with the Qing forces and fought Li Zicheng's rebel army.

sentences.zh: 康熙十三年，請選兵隨剿逆籓吳三桂，詔還牧聽調。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Kangxi, he requested to select troops to follow the suppression of the rebel prince Wu Sangui. An edict ordered him to return to his pastures and await dispatch.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 13 (1674) he offered troops for the campaign against the rebel Wu Sangui and was told to keep his herds at pasture until called.

sentences.zh: 十四年，隨大軍剿察哈爾叛人布林尼。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, he followed the main army to suppress the Chakhar rebel Bulunni.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he joined the main force in putting down the Chakhar rebel Bulunni.

sentences.zh: 十五年，徵兵赴河南，尋調荊州。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, troops were mobilized to Henan and soon transferred to Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year his troops were sent to Henan and soon afterward redeployed to Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 越三年，凱旋。

translations.literal: Three years later, they returned in triumph.
translations.idiomatic: Three years later they returned victorious.

sentences.zh: 二十八年秋，詔發喜峰口倉粟賑所屬貧戶。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the twenty-eighth year, an edict ordered grain from the Xifengkou granary distributed to relieve the poor households of the tribe.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the twenty-eighth year the court ordered grain from the Xifengkou storehouses distributed to needy households under the banner.

sentences.zh: 三十七年冬，遣官往教之耕，曰：「朕巡幸所經，見敖漢及柰曼諸部田土甚嘉，百穀可種。

translations.literal: In the winter of the thirty-seventh year, officials were sent to teach them farming. The emperor said: "On the route of my tour I have seen that the fields of the Aohan and Naiman tribes are excellent and all grains can be planted.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the thirty-seventh year officials were sent to teach them agriculture. The emperor said, "Where I have traveled I have seen that the land of the Aohan and Naiman banners is excellent and can bear every kind of grain.

sentences.zh: 如種穀多穫，則興安嶺左右無地可耕之人，就近貿糴，不須入邊巿米矣。

translations.literal: If grain planting yields much harvest, then people on both sides of the Greater Khingan who have no land to cultivate can trade for grain nearby and need not enter the border markets for rice.
translations.idiomatic: If the harvest is plentiful, people on both sides of the Greater Khingan who lack farmland can buy grain nearby and will not have to cross into the border markets for rice.

sentences.zh: 其向因種穀之地不可牧馬，未曾墾耕者，今酌留草茂之處為牧地，自兩不相妨。

translations.literal: Those who in the past did not reclaim and cultivate because grain fields could not pasture horses should now set aside grassy areas as pasture land as appropriate, so that the two need not interfere with each other.
translations.idiomatic: Those who had refrained from farming because grain land could not also pasture horses should now reserve grassy tracts for herding, so cultivation and grazing need no longer conflict.

sentences.zh: 且敖漢、柰曼蒙古以捕魚為業者眾，教之以引水灌田，彼亦易從。

translations.literal: Moreover, many Mongols of Aohan and Naiman make their living by fishing. If they are taught to irrigate fields by drawing water, they will easily follow.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, many Aohan and Naiman Mongols live by fishing; if they are taught to draw water for irrigation, they should take readily to it.

sentences.zh: 凡有利益於蒙古者，與王、台吉等相商而行。」

translations.literal: Whatever benefits the Mongols, discuss and carry out with the princes, taijis, and others."
translations.idiomatic: Whatever may benefit the Mongols, consult with the princes and taijis and then put it into practice."

sentences.zh: 雍正五年，以所部災，賜帑賑之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yongzheng, because the tribe suffered disaster, treasury funds were bestowed for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 5 (1727), after disaster struck the banner, the court granted treasury funds for relief.

sentences.zh: 九年，隨大軍剿噶爾丹策淩。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, he followed the main army to suppress Galdan Tseren.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he joined the main army in campaigning against Galdan Tseren.

sentences.zh: 所部一旗，駐固爾班圖爾噶山，與柰曼、翁牛特、巴林、紮嚕特、喀爾喀左翼、阿嚕科爾沁諸部統盟于昭烏達。

translations.literal: The tribe had one banner, stationed at Gurban Turgai Mountain. Together with Naiman, Ongniud, Baarin, Jarud, Khalkha Left, and Ar Khorchin, it was united in a league at Zhaowuda.
translations.idiomatic: The banner, headquartered at Gurban Turgai Mountain, formed the Zhaowuda League together with Naiman, Ongniud, Baarin, Jarud, Left Khalkha, and Ar Khorchin.

sentences.zh: 爵五：扎薩克多羅郡王一；

translations.literal: There were five ranks: one jasak prince of the first rank;
translations.idiomatic: There were five noble ranks: one jasak prince of the first rank;

sentences.zh: 附多羅郡王一；

translations.literal: one attached prince of the first rank;
translations.idiomatic: one attached prince of the first rank;

sentences.zh: 附固山貝子二，一由貝勒降襲；

translations.literal: two attached banner beile, one of whom inherited after demotion from beile rank;
translations.idiomatic: two attached banner beizi, one of whom had inherited after demotion from beile rank;

sentences.zh: 鎮國公一，由貝子降襲。

translations.literal: one defender duke of the state, who inherited after demotion from beizi rank.
translations.idiomatic: and one defender duke of the state, who had inherited after demotion from beizi rank.

sentences.zh: 是旗墾事最在先。

translations.literal: This banner's land reclamation came first among all.
translations.idiomatic: This banner was the first to undertake land reclamation.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶以後，屢申嚴禁。

translations.literal: After the Jiaqing reign, strict prohibitions were repeatedly issued.
translations.idiomatic: After the Jiaqing era the court repeatedly issued strict bans on the practice.

sentences.zh: 光緒十七年，金丹道匪楊悅春等糾眾為亂。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Guangxu, the Jindandao bandits Yang Yuechun and others rallied a crowd to rebel.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 17 (1891) the Jindandao bandit Yang Yuechun and his followers raised a rebellion.

sentences.zh: 十月，攻貝子德克沁府踞之，戕德克沁，四出紛擾，喀喇沁、土默持、翁牛特、柰曼諸部皆被兵。

translations.literal: In the tenth month they attacked and seized the residence of Beizi Dekexin, killed Dekexin, and spread disorder in all directions. The tribes of Kharchin, Tumed, Ongniud, and Naiman all suffered attack.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month they stormed and occupied the residence of Beizi Dekexin, killed him, and fanned out in raids that brought fighting to Kharchin, Tumed, Ongniud, and Naiman alike.

sentences.zh: 脅漢人為匪，遇蒙人則殺，占官署，毀教堂，蹂躪甚慘。

translations.literal: They coerced Han Chinese to become bandits, killed Mongols when they met them, seized government offices, destroyed churches, and ravaged the land with great cruelty.
translations.idiomatic: They forced Han Chinese into their ranks, slaughtered Mongols on sight, seized government offices, destroyed churches, and laid waste with appalling violence.

sentences.zh: 命直隸提督葉志超等剿之，至十二月始平。

translations.literal: The Zhili military governor Ye Zhichao and others were ordered to suppress them. It was not pacified until the twelfth month.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili military governor Ye Zhichao and others were ordered to suppress the uprising, which was not quelled until the twelfth month.

sentences.zh: 詔賑恤之，凡敖漢等五部八旗，為銀十七萬兩有奇，全濟民、蒙三十萬口有奇。

translations.literal: An edict ordered relief for them. For the eight banners of Aohan and four other tribes, more than one hundred seventy thousand taels of silver were granted, fully aiding more than three hundred thousand Han and Mongol mouths.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered relief: for the eight banners of Aohan and four allied tribes, more than 170,000 taels of silver were granted, aiding over 300,000 Han and Mongol people in all.

sentences.zh: 李鴻章會都統奎斌奏：「蒙古、客民結怨已深，一在佃種之交租，一在商賈之積欠。

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang together with the banner general Kuibin memorialized: "Resentment between Mongols and settler tenants runs deep, one cause being rent on leased fields and another being merchants' accumulated debts.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang and banner general Kuibin jointly memorialized: "Mongols and settler tenants are deeply at odds — over rents on leased fields on the one hand and merchants' unpaid debts on the other.

sentences.zh: 應更定新章，佃種蒙地者，由地方官徵收，蒙古王公派員領取；

translations.literal: New regulations should be drawn up. For those who tenant Mongol lands, local officials should collect the payments and Mongol princes should dispatch agents to receive them.
translations.idiomatic: New rules should be drawn up: tenants on Mongol land should pay through local officials, with Mongol princes sending agents to collect their shares;

sentences.zh: 商民領取蒙古貲本貿易，或彼此賒欠致有虧折，亦應送地方官持平論斷，毋稍偏倚。」

translations.literal: When merchants receive Mongol capital for trade, or when mutual credit leads to losses, these too should be referred to local officials for impartial judgment, without the slightest bias."
translations.idiomatic: and when merchants trade on Mongol capital or credit disputes lead to losses, cases should go to local officials for impartial settlement, without favor to either side."

sentences.zh: 此敖漢諸部蒙古、客民結隙根本所在，故鴻章等欲更張救之。

translations.literal: This was the root of the rift between the Mongols and settler tenants of the Aohan tribes, which is why Hongzhang and others wished to reform matters to remedy it.
translations.idiomatic: This was the root of the rift between Mongols and settler tenants in the Aohan region, which Hongzhang and his colleagues hoped to heal through reform.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，扎薩克郡王達木林達爾達克以充昭烏達盟長擾累屬下，違例科派，奪盟長及扎薩克。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, Jasak Prince Damulin Da'erdake, for burdening his subjects while serving as head of the Zhaowuda League and levying unauthorized exactions, was stripped of both league headship and jasak rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year Jasak Prince Damulin Da'erdake was stripped of his league headship and jasak rank for burdening his people as Zhaowuda league chief and levying unauthorized exactions.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，扎薩克郡王勒恩紮勒諾爾贊復被護衛刺死。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, Jasak Prince Le'enzhale Nuo'erzan was again stabbed to death by a guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year Jasak Prince Le'enzhale Nuo'erzan was assassinated by one of his guards.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，都統廷傑以置嗣未定，請理籓院慎擇親賢，速為承襲。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year, Banner General Tingjie, because the succession was unsettled, requested the Court of Colonial Affairs carefully to select a worthy kinsman and promptly confirm the inheritance.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year, with the succession still unsettled, banner general Tingjie asked the Court of Colonial Affairs to choose a worthy kinsman and confirm the inheritance without delay.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，以族人棍布劄布襲。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuantong, the clansman Gunbuzhabu succeeded to the title.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 1 (1909) the clansman Gunbuzhabu succeeded to the title.

sentences.zh: 二年，分置左、右二旗，以原有扎薩克者為左旗，別授郡王色淩端嚕布為右旗扎薩克。

translations.literal: In the second year, left and right banners were established. The original jasak became head of the left banner, and Prince Selengduanlubu was separately appointed jasak of the right banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year the banner was split into left and right divisions: the existing jasak retained the left banner, while Prince Selengduanlubu was appointed jasak of the new right banner.

sentences.zh: 左旗有佐領三十五，右旗有佐領二十。

translations.literal: The left banner had thirty-five zuolings; the right banner had twenty zuolings.
translations.idiomatic: The left banner had thirty-five zuolings and the right banner twenty.

sentences.zh: 柰曼部，在喜峰口外，至京師千有百一十里。

translations.literal: The Naiman tribe is beyond Xifeng Pass, one thousand one hundred and ten li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Naiman banner lay beyond Xifeng Pass, some 1,110 li from the capital.

sentences.zh: 東西距九十五里，南北距二百二十里。

translations.literal: East to west it measures ninety-five li; north to south two hundred twenty li.
translations.idiomatic: It measured 95 li from east to west and 220 li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 東喀爾喀左翼，西敖漢，南土默特，北翁牛特。

translations.literal: To the east is Khalkha Left; to the west Aohan; to the south Tumed; to the north Ongniud.
translations.idiomatic: Left Khalkha lay to the east, Aohan to the west, Tumed to the south, and Ongniud to the north.

sentences.zh: 元太祖嘗偕弟哈布圖哈薩爾平柰曼部，三傳至額森偉徵諾顏，即以為所部號。

translations.literal: The Yuan founding emperor once together with his brother Khabtu Khasar pacified the Naiman tribe. Three generations later came Esen Wei Zheng Noyan, who took that as the name of his tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Genghis Khan had once pacified the Naiman together with his brother Khabtu Khasar. Three generations later Esen Wei Zheng Noyan adopted that name for his people.

sentences.zh: 子袞楚克嗣，稱巴圖魯台吉，服屬於察哈爾。

translations.literal: His son Günchük succeeded, styled himself Batulu Taiji, and submitted to Chakhar.
translations.idiomatic: His son Günchük succeeded, took the title Batulu Taiji, and became subject to Chakhar.

sentences.zh: 以林丹汗不道，天聰元年，偕從子鄠齊爾等率屬來歸，詔還舊牧。

translations.literal: Because Ligdan Khan was unjust, in the first year of Tiancong, together with his nephew Öchir and others he led his people to submit. An edict ordered them to return to their old pastures.
translations.idiomatic: When Ligdan Khan proved tyrannical, in Tiancong 1 Günchük and his nephew Öchir brought their people over to the Qing and were sent back to their former grazing lands.

sentences.zh: 鄂齊爾以卒巡徼，斬察哈爾兵百，獲牲畜百餘獻，賜號和碩齊，賚甲一。

translations.literal: Öchir, while patrolling with soldiers, beheaded one hundred Chakhar troops, captured and presented more than one hundred head of livestock, and was granted the title Hoshoqi and given one suit of armor.
translations.idiomatic: Öchir, on patrol with his men, killed a hundred Chakhar soldiers, presented more than a hundred head of livestock as booty, and was granted the title Hoshoqi along with a suit of armor.

sentences.zh: 八年，遣大臣赴碩翁科爾定諸籓牧，以巴克阿爾和碩、巴噶什魯蘇台為柰曼界。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, a minister was dispatched to Shüngön Köl to fix the pastures of the frontier tribes. Bak Ar Hoshu and Bagashirusu Tai were set as the Naiman boundary.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year a minister went to Shüngön Köl to demarcate frontier pastures, fixing Bak Ar Hoshu and Bagashirusu Tai as the Naiman border.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，授扎薩克，爵多羅達爾漢郡王。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde, he was appointed jasak and enfeoffed as Prince of the First Rank with the designation Darhan.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1 he was appointed jasak and ennobled as a first-rank Darhan prince.

sentences.zh: 先是，所部阿邦和碩齊從大軍剿茂明安部逃賊有功，至是以宣諭朝鮮，袞楚克遣屬岱都齊齎書從。

translations.literal: Earlier, Abang Hoshoqi of the tribe had merit in following the main army to suppress fugitive bandits of the Minggan tribe. At this time, when an envoy was sent to announce the edict to Korea, Günchük dispatched his follower Daiduchi to carry the letter along.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Abang Hoshoqi of the banner had distinguished himself hunting down Minggan fugitives with the main army. Now, when an envoy was sent to proclaim the edict in Korea, Günchük sent his follower Daiduchi to carry the letter.

sentences.zh: 遇明皮島兵，狙擊之，斬賊二，被創還，悉蒙獎賚。

translations.literal: They encountered Ming troops from Pidao, ambushed them, beheaded two bandits, returned wounded, and all received rewards.
translations.idiomatic: They met Ming troops from Pidao, ambushed them, killed two enemy soldiers, and returned wounded; all were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 五年，遣屬紮丹隨大軍征索倫，凱旋，得優賜。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, he dispatched his follower Zhadan to follow the main army in campaigning against the Solon. On triumphant return, he received generous rewards.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he sent his follower Zhadan with the main army against the Solon; on their return he received generous rewards.

sentences.zh: 七年，復遣屬善丹、薩爾圖隨征明，由黃崖口入邊，下薊州，趨山東，攻克袞州。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, he again dispatched his followers Shandan and Sartu to follow the campaign against Ming. They entered the frontier through Huangyakou, took Jizhou, pressed into Shandong, and captured Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he again sent Shandan and Sartu on the Ming campaign; they entered through Huangyakou, took Jizhou, pushed into Shandong, and captured Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 八年，善丹來獻俘，賜宴。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Shandan came to present captives and was granted a banquet.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Shandan came to present captives and was given a banquet in his honor.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入山海關，擊流賊李自成。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi, he followed the army through Shanhaiguan and attacked the bandit Li Zicheng.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he marched through Shanhaiguan with the Qing forces and fought Li Zicheng's rebel army.

sentences.zh: 康熙十四年，察哈爾布林尼叛，扎薩克郡王紮木三應之，徙察罕郭勒，與布林尼賊壘聯聲援，且遣党煽諸扎薩克。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Kangxi, the Chakhar rebel Bulunni rose in rebellion. Jasak Prince Zhamusan responded to him, moved to Chagan Gol, linked his camp in mutual support with Bulunni's bandits, and sent agents to incite other jasaks.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 14 the Chakhar rebel Bulunni rose in revolt. Jasak Prince Zhamusan joined him, moved to Chagan Gol, coordinated with Bulunni's forces, and sent agents to incite other jasaks.

sentences.zh: 詔撫遠大將軍信郡王鄂扎率師討，至達祿，布林尼敗遁，為科爾沁額駙沙津陣斬。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Pacification Commissioner Prince Xin Eza to lead troops to suppress them. At Dalu, Bulunni was defeated and fled, and was beheaded in battle by Khorchin imperial son-in-law Shajin.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification Commissioner Prince Xin Eza was ordered to lead troops against them. At Dalu, Bulunni was routed and fled, then was slain in battle by the Khorchin imperial son-in-law Shajin.

sentences.zh: 紮木三蹙縛乞罪，特旨貸死。

translations.literal: Zhamusan was cornered, bound, and begged for mercy. A special edict spared his life.
translations.idiomatic: Cornered and captured, Zhamusan pleaded for mercy and was spared by special edict.

sentences.zh: 更優獎不附逆諸台吉，鄂齊爾由一等台吉襲扎薩克郡王爵，烏勒木濟由二等台吉晉貝子，格哷爾由二等台吉晉輔國公，烏爾圖納素圖由三等台吉晉一等台吉，鄂齊爾長子額爾德尼授三等台吉。

translations.literal: Those taijis who had not joined the rebellion were further rewarded with honors. Öchir inherited the jasak princely rank from first-class taiji. Ulemji was promoted from second-class taiji to beizi. Gele'er was promoted from second-class taiji to auxiliary state duke. Urtnasu was promoted from third-class taiji to first-class taiji. Öchir's eldest son Erdeni was granted third-class taiji.
translations.idiomatic: The taijis who had stayed loyal were richly rewarded: Öchir inherited the jasak princely rank from first-class taiji; Ulemji rose from second-class taiji to beizi; Gele'er from second-class taiji to auxiliary state duke; Urtnasu from third-class to first-class taiji; and Öchir's eldest son Erdeni was granted third-class taiji.

sentences.zh: 二十年，詔發喜峰口倉粟賑所屬貧戶。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, an edict ordered grain from the Xifengkou granary distributed to relieve the poor households of the tribe.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year the court ordered grain from the Xifengkou storehouses distributed to needy households under the banner.

sentences.zh: 雍正五年，所部歉收，賜帑賑之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yongzheng, the tribe had a poor harvest and treasury funds were bestowed for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 5 a poor harvest struck the banner and the court granted treasury funds for relief.

sentences.zh: 九年，隨大軍剿噶爾丹策淩。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, he followed the main army to suppress Galdan Tseren.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he joined the main army in campaigning against Galdan Tseren.

sentences.zh: 初，柰曼與敖漢逢國家典禮及征伐事，先後偕來，位秩如一。

translations.literal: Initially, when Naiman and Aohan encountered state ceremonies and military campaigns, they came together one after another and held equal rank.
translations.idiomatic: At first Naiman and Aohan had alike answered the court's calls to ceremony and war, arriving in close succession and holding equal rank.

sentences.zh: 獨紮木三懷貳，遂不齒於敖漢。

translations.literal: Only Zhamusan harbored disloyalty, and so was not counted among Aohan.
translations.idiomatic: Only Zhamusan's disloyalty kept Naiman from standing on a par with Aohan.

sentences.zh: 迨鄂齊爾重膺錫封，奉職惟謹，而荷恩亦如故焉。

translations.literal: When Öchir again received enfeoffment, he served his duties with utmost care, and the grace shown him was as before.
translations.idiomatic: Once Öchir received a new enfeoffment and served with scrupulous loyalty, the court's favor toward Naiman was restored as before.

sentences.zh: 所部一旗，駐彰武台，其爵為扎薩克多羅達爾漢郡王。

translations.literal: The tribe had one banner, stationed at Zhangwu Tai. Its rank was jasak prince of the first rank with the designation Darhan.
translations.idiomatic: The banner was headquartered at Zhangwu Tai, its chief holding the rank of jasak first-rank Darhan prince.

sentences.zh: 道光二十七年，以壽安固倫公主指配柰曼扎薩克郡王阿完都窪第紮布之子德木楚克紮布，授固倫額駙。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year of Daoguang, Princess Shou'an Gurun was betrothed to Demchugjab, son of Naiman Jasak Prince Awangduwadijab, and he was granted the title of Gurun imperial son-in-law.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 27 Princess Shou'an Gurun was betrothed to Demchugjab, son of Naiman Jasak Prince Awangduwadijab, who was made a Gurun imperial son-in-law.

sentences.zh: 旋襲爵職。

translations.literal: He soon inherited the title and office.
translations.idiomatic: He soon succeeded to the princely title and office.

sentences.zh: 同治四年，卒，追賜親王銜。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tongzhi, he died, and posthumously was granted the designation of prince.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Tongzhi 4 (1865) and was posthumously granted princely rank.

sentences.zh: 光緒十七年，金丹道匪之變，是部亦被擾。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Guangxu, during the Jindandao bandit uprising, this tribe also suffered disturbance.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jindandao uprising of Guangxu 17 this banner was also ravaged.

sentences.zh: 事平，賑恤之。

translations.literal: When the matter was settled, relief was granted.
translations.idiomatic: After order was restored, the court granted relief.

sentences.zh: 有佐領五十。

translations.literal: It had fifty zuolings.
translations.idiomatic: The banner had fifty zuolings.

sentences.zh: 巴林部，在古北口外，至京師九百六十里。

translations.literal: The Baarin tribe is beyond Gubeikou, nine hundred sixty li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Baarin banner lay beyond Gubeikou, 960 li from the capital.

sentences.zh: 東西距二百五十一里，南北距二百三十三里。

translations.literal: East to west it measures two hundred fifty-one li; north to south two hundred thirty-three li.
translations.idiomatic: It measured 251 li from east to west and 233 li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 東阿嚕科爾沁，西克什克騰，南翁牛特，北烏珠穆沁。

translations.literal: To the east is Ar Khorchin; to the west Hexigten; to the south Ongniud; to the north Ujumqin.
translations.idiomatic: Ar Khorchin lay to the east, Hexigten to the west, Ongniud to the south, and Ujumqin to the north.

sentences.zh: 元太祖十六世孫阿爾楚博羅特生和爾朔齊哈薩爾。

translations.literal: Altai Bolot, sixteenth-generation descendant of the Yuan founding emperor, begot Khorshichi Khasar.
translations.idiomatic: Altai Bolot, sixteenth-generation scion of Genghis Khan, fathered Khorshichi Khasar.

sentences.zh: 子蘇巴海，稱達爾漢諾顏，號所部曰巴林。

translations.literal: His son Subuhai styled himself Darhan Noyan and called his tribe Baarin.
translations.idiomatic: His son Subuhai took the title Darhan Noyan and gave his people the name Baarin.

sentences.zh: 子巴噶巴圖爾嗣。

translations.literal: His son Baghabatur succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: His son Baghabatur succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 有子三：長額布格岱洪巴圖魯，次和托果爾昂哈，次色特爾。

translations.literal: He had three sons: the elder Ebugedei Hong Batur, the second Hotogor Anggha, and the third Setel.
translations.idiomatic: He had three sons: the eldest Ebugedei Hong Batur, the second Hotogor Anggha, and the third Setel.

sentences.zh: 初皆服屬於喀爾喀。

translations.literal: At first they all submitted to Khalkha.
translations.idiomatic: At first they had all been subject to Khalkha.

sentences.zh: 天命四年，額布格岱洪巴圖魯偕喀爾喀部長遣使乞盟，允之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tianming, Ebugedei Hong Batur together with the Khalkha chief dispatched envoys to request alliance, and it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianming 4 Ebugedei Hong Batur and the Khalkha chief sent envoys to seek alliance, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 十一年春，以背盟私與明和，大軍往討，陣斬台吉囊努克。

translations.literal: In the spring of the eleventh year, for breaking the alliance and privately making peace with Ming, the main army went to punish them and beheaded Taiji Nangnuk in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the eleventh year, for breaking the alliance and secretly treating with Ming, the Qing army marched against them and killed Taiji Nangnuk in battle.

sentences.zh: 冬，討紮嚕特，詔分軍入部境以張兵勢，焚原驅哨而還。

translations.literal: In winter, campaigning against Jarud, an edict ordered troops divided to enter the tribal territory to display military might, burn the plains, drive off scouts, and return.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, campaigning against Jarud, the court ordered detachments into Baarin territory to show force, burn the grasslands, drive off scouts, and withdraw.

sentences.zh: 會察哈爾林丹汗掠其諸部，台吉皆奔依科爾沁。

translations.literal: Just then Chakhar Ligdan Khan plundered their tribes, and the taijis all fled to depend on Khorchin.
translations.idiomatic: About then Ligdan Khan of Chakhar raided their banners, and the taijis all fled to Khorchin for refuge.

sentences.zh: 天聰二年，色特爾率子色布騰及額布格岱洪巴圖魯子色棱、和托果爾昂哈子滿珠習禮等，自科爾沁來歸，優賚撫輯之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tiancong, Setel led his son Sebeten and Ebugedei Hong Batur's son Seleng, Hotogor Anggha's son Manzhushiri, and others to submit from Khorchin; they were generously rewarded and pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 2 (1628) Setel brought his son Sebeten, together with Seleng son of Ebugedei Hong Batur, Manzhushiri son of Hotogor Anggha, and others from Khorchin to submit to the Qing. The court treated them generously and settled them in their new allegiance.

sentences.zh: 三年，從征明，由養息穆河入大安口，克遵化。

translations.literal: In the third year, he followed the campaign against Ming, entered Da'an Pass by way of the Yangximu River, and captured Zunhua.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he joined the campaign against Ming, entered through Da'an Pass via the Yangximu River, and took Zunhua.

sentences.zh: 四年，攻昌黎，與紮嚕特兵圍城北。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, he attacked Changli and, together with Jarud troops, besieged the north of the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he attacked Changli and, with Jarud forces, invested the north side of the city.

sentences.zh: 六年，從略大同、宣府邊。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, he followed in raiding the Datong and Xuanfu border.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he joined a raid along the Datong and Xuanfu frontier.

sentences.zh: 八年五月，會兵紮木哈克征察哈爾，賜宰桑布兌山津雕鞍良馬，遂由獨石口征明朔州，克堡八。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the eighth year, he joined forces at Zhamuhake to campaign against Chakhar and was granted a carved saddle and fine horses by the zaisang Budui Shanjin; he then campaigned against Ming Shuozhou by way of Dushikou and captured eight forts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the eighth year he mustered at Zhamuhake for the campaign against Chakhar and received a carved saddle and fine horses from the zaisang Budui Shanjin. He then marched on Ming Shuozhou through Dushikou and captured eight forts.

sentences.zh: 十月，遣大臣赴碩翁科爾定諸籓牧，以扈拉瑚琥、呼布裏都、克哩葉哈達、瑚濟爾阿達克為巴林界。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, a minister was dispatched to Shüngön Köl to fix the pastures of the frontier tribes; Hulahu Hu, Hoburidu, Keliyehada, and Hujieradake were set as the Baarin boundary.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month a minister went to Shüngön Köl to demarcate frontier pastures, fixing Hulahu Hu, Hoburidu, Keliyehada, and Hujieradake as the Baarin border.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，選兵從征明。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde, selected troops followed the campaign against Ming.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1 (1636) selected troops joined the campaign against Ming.

sentences.zh: 三年，自牆子嶺入明邊，樹雲梯攻城，台吉阿玉什屬索爾古先登，克之。

translations.literal: In the third year, entering the Ming border by way of Qiangzi Ridge, they erected cloud ladders to attack the city; taiji Ayushi's subordinate Sorhu scaled first, and it was captured.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year they entered Ming territory through Qiangzi Ridge, set scaling ladders against the walls, and took the city when Sorhu, a man under taiji Ayushi, was first to climb over.

sentences.zh: 四年，圍錦州。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, he besieged Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he joined the siege of Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 六年，圍松山。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, he besieged Songshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he joined the siege of Songshan.

sentences.zh: 七年，獻俘，賚將弁幣。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, he presented captives and was rewarded with gifts for officers.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he presented prisoners of war and received rewards of silks and gifts for his officers.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入山海關，擊流賊李自成。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi, he followed in entering Shanhaiguan and attacking the bandit Li Zicheng.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 (1644) he followed the Qing army through Shanhaiguan and fought the rebel Li Zicheng.

sentences.zh: 五年，詔編所部佐領，以滿珠習禮掌左翼，爵固山貝子；

translations.literal: In the fifth year, an edict ordered the registration of zuolings for the banner; Manzhushiri was put in charge of the left wing and enfeoffed as gushan beizi;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year an edict registered the banner's zuolings, appointing Manzhushiri to head the left wing and ennobling him as gushan beizi;

sentences.zh: 色布騰掌右翼，爵多羅郡王：各授扎薩克。

translations.literal: Sebeten was put in charge of the right wing and enfeoffed as duoluo junwang: each was granted jasak rank.
translations.idiomatic: Sebeten was placed at the head of the right wing and ennobled as duoluo junwang; each was appointed jasak.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十三年，上幸塞外，駐蹕烏拉岱，兩翼扎薩克率諸台吉來朝，賜冠服、弓矢、銀幣有差。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year of Kangxi, the emperor toured beyond the passes, halted at Wuladai, and the jasaks of both wings led the taijis to audience; caps and robes, bows and arrows, and silver coins were granted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 23 the emperor traveled beyond the Great Wall and halted at Wuladai. The jasaks of both wings brought their taijis to audience, and each received caps and robes, bows and arrows, and silver in varying measure.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，詔發古北口倉粟賑所屬貧戶。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, an edict ordered grain from the Gubeikou granary distributed to relieve the banner's poor households.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year an edict released grain from the Gubeikou granary to relieve poor households within the banner.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，命額駙阿喇布坦率兩翼兵四百，赴葫蘆郭勒偵噶勒丹。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, the imperial son-in-law Alabutan was ordered to lead four hundred troops of both wings to Hulu Gol to scout Galdan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year the imperial son-in-law Alabutan was ordered to lead four hundred men from both wings to Hulu Gol to reconnoiter Galdan.

sentences.zh: 是役也，色布騰子格哷爾圖、納木紮，孫納木達克、桑哩達、烏爾袞，暨族台吉沙克塔爾等皆從。

translations.literal: In this campaign, Sebeten's sons Gele'ertu and Namjaa, his grandsons Namudak, Sanglida, and Urgun, and the clan taiji Shakhtar and others all followed.
translations.idiomatic: In that campaign Sebeten's sons Gele'ertu and Namjaa took part, as did his grandsons Namudak, Sanglida, and Urgun, together with the clan taiji Shakhtar and others.

sentences.zh: 格哷爾圖尤衝鋒奮擊，師旋，得優賚。

translations.literal: Gele'ertu especially charged the front lines and fought fiercely; when the army returned, he received a generous reward.
translations.idiomatic: Gele'ertu distinguished himself in the van with fierce attacks, and when the army returned he was richly rewarded.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，以噶勒丹掠喀爾喀至巴顏烏蘭，詔檄敖漢、柰曼兵赴阿喇布坦軍，並命納木達克、烏爾袞等防烏珠穆沁汛。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year, because Galdan raided Khalkha as far as Bayan Ulan, an edict summoned Aohan and Naiman troops to Alabutan's army and also ordered Namudak, Urgun, and others to guard the Ujumqin border.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year, after Galdan raided Khalkha as far as Bayan Ulan, an edict called up Aohan and Naiman troops for Alabutan's command and ordered Namudak, Urgun, and others to hold the Ujumqin frontier.

sentences.zh: 是年所部歉收，詔發坡賴屯米賑之。

translations.literal: That year the banner had a poor harvest, and an edict ordered rice from Polai Tun distributed in relief.
translations.idiomatic: That year the banner suffered crop failure, and an edict ordered relief grain from Polai Tun.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，命護軍統領鄂克濟哈、學士蘇赫納往會扎薩克等，將現貯巴林米千石散賑。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year, Guard Commander Ekejeha and academician Suhena were ordered to go and meet the jasaks and others and distribute one thousand shi of grain presently stored at Baarin for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-eighth year Guard Commander Ekejeha and academician Suhena were sent to join the jasaks and distribute one thousand shi of grain stored at Baarin for famine relief.

sentences.zh: 若人眾米寡，再運坡賴米賑給。

translations.literal: If the people were many and the grain few, Polai grain was again transported for relief.
translations.idiomatic: If the population proved too large for the available grain, more was brought from Polai for distribution.

sentences.zh: 雍正九年，隨大軍剿噶勒丹策淩。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Yongzheng, he followed the main army to suppress Galdan Tseren.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 9 he joined the main army in campaigning against Galdan Tseren.

sentences.zh: 二等台吉璘瞻追賊察巴罕河，護駝馬；

translations.literal: Second-class taiji Linzhan pursued the enemy at Chabahan River and protected the camels and horses;
translations.idiomatic: Second-class taiji Linzhan pursued the enemy to the Chabahan River and guarded the baggage camels and horses;

sentences.zh: 又擊之於塔爾勒圖、固爾班什勒諸處。

translations.literal: He again attacked them at Tarletu, Gurban Shile, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: and again struck them at Tarletu, Gurban Shile, and other points.

sentences.zh: 敘功，晉授一等台吉。

translations.literal: When merits were recorded, he was promoted and granted first-class taiji rank.
translations.idiomatic: For these services he was promoted to first-class taiji.

sentences.zh: 所部二旗：右翼駐托缽山，左翼駐阿察圖拖羅海。

translations.literal: The banner had two wings: the right wing was stationed at Tubo Mountain and the left wing at Achatu Tuoluo Hai.
translations.idiomatic: The banner comprised two wings: the right wing was headquartered at Tubo Mountain and the left at Achatu Tuoluo Hai.

sentences.zh: 爵四：親王品級扎薩克多羅郡王一，扎薩克固山貝子一，附固山貝子二。

translations.literal: There were four ranks: one jasak duoluo junwang of princely rank, one jasak gushan beizi, and two supplementary gushan beizi.
translations.idiomatic: There were four noble ranks: one jasak duoluo junwang of princely standing, one jasak gushan beizi, and two supplementary gushan beizi.

sentences.zh: 光緒十七年，金丹道匪之變，賊渠李國珍擾至是部那林溝地，葉志超遣軍擊平之。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Guangxu, during the Jindandao bandit uprising, the bandit chief Li Guozhen disturbed as far as the Nalin Gou area of this banner; Ye Zhichao dispatched troops to attack and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 17, during the Jindandao rebellion, the bandit leader Li Guozhen raided into this banner as far as Nalin Gou. Ye Zhichao sent troops that defeated and suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，以是部墾地置林西縣，隸赤峰直隸州。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year, Linxi County was established on opened lands of this banner and made subordinate to Chifeng Zhili Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year reclaimed land within the banner was organized as Linxi County, subordinate to Chifeng Zhili Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 左翼有佐領十六，右翼有佐領二十六。

translations.literal: The left wing had sixteen zuolings and the right wing twenty-six zuolings.
translations.idiomatic: The left wing had sixteen zuolings and the right wing twenty-six.

sentences.zh: 紮嚕特部，在喜峰口外，至京師千五百一十里。

translations.literal: The Jarud tribe is beyond Xifengkou, one thousand five hundred ten li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Jarud banner lay beyond Xifengkou, 1,510 li from the capital.

sentences.zh: 東西距百二十五里，南北距四百六十里。

translations.literal: East to west it measures one hundred twenty-five li; north to south four hundred sixty li.
translations.idiomatic: It measured 125 li from east to west and 460 li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 東科爾沁，西界阿嚕科爾沁，南喀爾喀左翼，北烏珠穆沁。

translations.literal: To the east is Khorchin; to the west the border is Ar Khorchin; to the south Khalkha Left; to the north Ujumqin.
translations.idiomatic: Khorchin lay to the east, Ar Khorchin marked the western border, Left Khalkha to the south, and Ujumqin to the north.

sentences.zh: 元太祖十八世孫烏巴什稱偉徵諾顏，號所部曰紮嚕特。

translations.literal: Ubashi, eighteenth-generation descendant of the Yuan founding emperor, styled himself Wei Zheng Noyan and called his tribe Jarud.
translations.idiomatic: Ubashi, eighteenth-generation scion of Genghis Khan, took the title Wei Zheng Noyan and gave his people the name Jarud.

sentences.zh: 子二：長巴顏達爾伊勒登，次都喇勒諾顏。

translations.literal: He had two sons: the elder Bayan Dar Ileden and the second Dulai Noyan.
translations.idiomatic: He had two sons: the elder Bayan Dar Ileden and the younger Dulai Noyan.

sentences.zh: 巴顏達爾伊勒登子五：長忠圖，傳子內齊，相繼稱汗；

translations.literal: Bayan Dar Ileden had five sons: the elder Zhongtu, transmitted to his son Neiji, who successively styled himself khan;
translations.idiomatic: Bayan Dar Ileden had five sons. The eldest, Zhongtu, was succeeded by his son Neiji, who in turn took the title of khan;

sentences.zh: 次賡根；

translations.literal: the second Gengen;
translations.idiomatic: the second was Gengen;

sentences.zh: 次忠嫩；

translations.literal: the third Zhongnen;
translations.idiomatic: the third was Zhongnen;

sentences.zh: 次果弼爾圖，次昂安。

translations.literal: the fourth Guobirtu and the fifth Angan.
translations.idiomatic: the fourth Guobirtu and the fifth Angan.

sentences.zh: 都喇勒諾顏子二：長色本，次瑪尼。

translations.literal: Dulai Noyan had two sons: the elder Seben and the second Mani.
translations.idiomatic: Dulai Noyan had two sons: the elder Seben and the younger Mani.

sentences.zh: 初皆服屬於喀爾喀。

translations.literal: At first they all submitted to Khalkha.
translations.idiomatic: At first they had all been subject to Khalkha.

sentences.zh: 太祖高皇帝甲寅年，內齊以其妹歸我貝勒莽古爾泰；

translations.literal: In the jiayin year of Taizu the High Emperor, Neiji gave his younger sister in marriage to our prince Manggūltai;
translations.idiomatic: In the jiayin year of the founding emperor's reign, Neiji gave his younger sister in marriage to Prince Manggūltai;

sentences.zh: 忠嫩及從弟額爾濟格亦來締★L5。

translations.literal: Zhongnen and his younger cousin Erjige also came to form an alliance.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongnen and his cousin Erjige also came to enter into alliance.

sentences.zh: 天命四年秋，大軍征明鐵嶺，從。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the fourth year of Tianming, the main army campaigned against Ming at Tieling, and he followed.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of Tianming 4 he followed the main army in the campaign against Ming at Tieling.

sentences.zh: 色本偕從兄巴克等隨喀爾喀台吉宰賽以兵萬餘助明，為我軍陣擒。

translations.literal: Seben together with his elder cousin Bak and others followed Khalkha taiji Zaisai with more than ten thousand troops to aid Ming and was captured by our army in battle formation.
translations.idiomatic: Seben, his elder cousin Bak, and others joined Khalkha taiji Zaisai with more than ten thousand men to aid Ming, but were taken prisoner by the Qing army in battle.

sentences.zh: 冬，內齊、額爾濟格、額騰、鄂爾齋圖、多爾濟桑、阿爾齋弼登圖偕喀爾卓哩克圖洪巴圖魯等遣使乞盟，許之，遣大臣往蒞盟。

translations.literal: In winter, Neiji, Erjige, Eteng, Erzee, Dorji Sang, Arqibidengtu, together with Karjoliktu Hong Batur and others, dispatched envoys to beg alliance; it was granted, and a minister was sent to preside over the alliance.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Neiji, Erjige, Eteng, Erzee, Dorji Sang, and Arqibidengtu, together with Karjoliktu Hong Batur and others, sent envoys to seek alliance. The request was granted and a minister was dispatched to oversee the covenant.

sentences.zh: 其宰桑扣肯屬有來奔者，上以盟不可渝，拒弗納。

translations.literal: Among their zaisang Koken's subordinates there were some who came to flee; the emperor, because the alliance could not be violated, refused and did not accept them.
translations.idiomatic: When some men under their zaisang Koken came over to the Qing side, the emperor refused to receive them, holding that the alliance must not be broken.

sentences.zh: 旋釋色本、巴克歸。

translations.literal: Soon Seben and Bak were released to return.
translations.idiomatic: Seben and Bak were soon released and sent home.

sentences.zh: 八年，巴克來朝，命釋其質子鄂齊爾桑與俱歸。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Bak came to audience, and an order was issued to release his hostage son Okirsang to return together with him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Bak came to court, and the emperor ordered his hostage son Okirsang released to return with him.

sentences.zh: 而忠喇、昂安等屢以兵掠我使齎往科爾沁之服物及馬牛。

translations.literal: But Zhongla, Angan, and others repeatedly with troops plundered the robes and gifts our envoys were bearing to Khorchin, as well as horses and cattle.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Zhongla, Angan, and others repeatedly raided Qing envoys carrying robes and gifts bound for Khorchin, seizing horses and cattle as well.

sentences.zh: 上遣軍征之，斬昂安，俘其眾。

translations.literal: The emperor dispatched an army to campaign against them, beheaded Angan, and captured his followers.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent troops against them, killed Angan, and captured his followers.

sentences.zh: 忠嫩子桑圖以孥被擒，來朝乞哀，詔歸令完聚。

translations.literal: Zhongnen's son Santu, captured together with his wife and children, came to audience begging mercy; an edict ordered him returned and allowed to reunite his household.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongnen's son Santu, taken prisoner with his family, came to court to plead for mercy. An edict restored him so that he might rebuild his household.

sentences.zh: 未幾，所部諸台吉復背盟，襲我使固什於漢察喇及遼河畔，掠財物。

translations.literal: Before long the banner's taijis again broke the alliance, attacked our envoy Gushi at Hanchala and on the banks of the Liao River, and plundered goods.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the banner's taijis broke the alliance again, ambushed the Qing envoy Gushi at Hanchala and on the Liao River, and looted his goods.

sentences.zh: 十一年，命大貝勒代善率師往討，斬鄂爾齋圖，擒巴克等凡十四台吉。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, the great prince Daišan was ordered to lead an army to punish them; Erzee was beheaded and Bak and others, fourteen taijis in all, were captured.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year the great prince Daišan was ordered to lead an punitive expedition. Erzee was killed, and Bak and thirteen other taijis were captured.

sentences.zh: 師還，仍詔釋歸。

translations.literal: When the army returned, an edict still ordered them released and sent back.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned, they were again ordered released and sent home.

sentences.zh: 尋為察哈爾林丹汗所掠，往依科爾沁。

translations.literal: Soon they were plundered by Chakhar's Ligdan Khan and went to depend on Khorchin.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Ligdan Khan of Chakhar raided them, and they fled to Khorchin for refuge.

sentences.zh: 天聰二年，內齊、色本等先後率屬來歸。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tiancong, Neiji, Seben, and others successively led their followers to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 2 Neiji, Seben, and others successively brought their people over to the Qing.

sentences.zh: 台吉喀巴海殺察哈爾台吉噶爾圖，以俘七百獻，賜號偉徵。

translations.literal: Taiji Kabahai killed Chakhar taiji Galtu and presented seven hundred captives; he was granted the title Wei Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: Taiji Kabahai killed Chakhar taiji Galtu and presented seven hundred captives, for which he was granted the title Wei Zheng.

sentences.zh: 三年，奉敕定隨征軍令。

translations.literal: In the third year, he received an imperial order fixing the military regulations for campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he received an imperial order establishing regulations for troops on campaign.

sentences.zh: 以越界駐牧自議罪，內齊、色本、瑪尼及果弼爾圖、巴雅爾圖、岱青，請各罰駝十、馬百，詔寬之，各罰馬一。

translations.literal: For overstepping boundaries in grazing they themselves proposed punishment: Neiji, Seben, Mani, Guobirtu, Bayartu, and Daiqing requested that each be fined ten camels and one hundred horses; an edict was lenient, and each was fined one horse.
translations.idiomatic: For grazing beyond their allotted pastures Neiji, Seben, Mani, Guobirtu, Bayartu, and Daiqing voluntarily proposed fines of ten camels and one hundred horses each. The court showed leniency and fined each of them one horse.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，隨征明，入龍井關，克遵化，圍其都。

translations.literal: That winter, following the campaign against Ming, they entered Longjing Pass, captured Zunhua, and besieged the capital.
translations.idiomatic: That winter they joined the campaign against Ming, entered through Longjing Pass, took Zunhua, and invested the Ming capital.

sentences.zh: 明兵屯城東，蒙古諸部不俟整隊，驟進失利，惟色本及瑪尼敗敵，得優賚。

translations.literal: Ming troops were encamped east of the city; the Mongol tribes, without waiting to form ranks, suddenly advanced and suffered defeat, but only Seben and Mani defeated the enemy and received generous rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Ming troops were encamped east of the city. The Mongol contingents attacked before the lines were properly formed and were beaten back, but Seben and Mani routed the enemy and were richly rewarded.

sentences.zh: 五年春，詔議台吉岱青罪。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifth year, an edict ordered discussion of taiji Daiqing's guilt.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fifth year an edict called for deliberation on the offenses of taiji Daiqing.

sentences.zh: 先是大貝勒代善陣擒岱青子善都，往奔科爾沁。

translations.literal: Previously the great prince Daišan had captured Daiqing's son Shandu in battle formation, and he fled to Khorchin.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the great prince Daišan had taken Daiqing's son Shandu prisoner in battle, after which Shandu fled to Khorchin.

sentences.zh: 越二年歸，詔留贍養。

translations.literal: After two years he returned, and an edict ordered him kept for support.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later he returned, and an edict ordered that he be kept on for maintenance.

sentences.zh: 嗣從大軍征明，貝勒莽古爾泰與明兵戰都城東，岱青、善都遁走。

translations.literal: Later, following the main army in campaigning against Ming, Prince Manggūltai fought Ming troops east of the capital, and Daiqing and Shandu fled.
translations.idiomatic: Later, on campaign against Ming, Prince Manggūltai fought Ming troops east of the capital while Daiqing and Shandu slipped away.

sentences.zh: 又誣訐貝勒阿濟格縱屬殺人。

translations.literal: He also falsely accused Prince Ajige of letting his subordinates kill people.
translations.idiomatic: He also lodged a false charge that Prince Ajige had allowed his men to commit murder.

sentences.zh: 至是，論罪應斬，上特宥之，奪所屬人戶分給莽古爾泰、阿濟格。

translations.literal: At this point, judged guilty of a crime deserving execution, the emperor specially pardoned him, stripped his subordinate households, and distributed them to Manggūltai and Ajige.
translations.idiomatic: On these grounds he was judged deserving of death, but the emperor specially pardoned him, stripped him of his dependent households, and divided them between Manggūltai and Ajige.

sentences.zh: 六年，內齊、色本、瑪尼、喀巴海等從征察哈爾，諭獎其實心效力。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Neiji, Seben, Mani, Kabahai, and others followed the campaign against Chakhar and were instructed to be rewarded for their sincere service.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Neiji, Seben, Mani, Kabahai, and others joined the campaign against Chakhar and were commended for their loyal service.

sentences.zh: 尋隨貝勒阿濟格略明大同、宣府邊。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he followed Prince Ajige in raiding the Ming Datong and Xuanfu border.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward they followed Prince Ajige in raiding the Ming frontier around Datong and Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 八年，由獨石口進攻朔州。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, he advanced to attack Shuozhou by way of Dushikou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year they advanced on Shuozhou through Dushikou.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，遣大臣赴碩翁科爾定諸籓牧，以諾綽噶爾多布圖烏魯木為紮嚕特界。

translations.literal: That winter, a minister was dispatched to Shüngön Köl to fix the pastures of the frontier tribes; Nuochuo Gartu Wulumu was set as the Jarud boundary.
translations.idiomatic: That winter a minister went to Shüngön Köl to demarcate frontier pastures, fixing Nuochuo Gartu Wulumu as the Jarud border.

sentences.zh: 崇德二年，由朝鮮進征瓦爾喀。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chongde, he advanced to campaign against Warka from Korea.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 2 he marched against the Warka Jurchens from Korea.

sentences.zh: 三年，隨征喀爾喀扎薩克圖汗。

translations.literal: In the third year, he followed the campaign against Khalkha Jasaktu Khan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he joined the campaign against Khalkha Jasaktu Khan.

sentences.zh: 五年春，從征索倫，賜台吉桑古爾及阿玉什、琥賴、阿爾蘇瑚、岳博果等蟒服、貂裘、甲胄、弓矢。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifth year, he followed the campaign against the Solon and was granted python robes, sable furs, armor, and bows and arrows to taiji Sanguer, Ayushi, Hulai, Arsu Hu, Yueboguo, and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fifth year he joined the campaign against the Solon. Taiji Sanguer, Ayushi, Hulai, Arsu Hu, Yueboguo, and others received python robes, sable furs, armor, and bows and arrows.

sentences.zh: 冬，以台吉肯哲赫追擒茂明安逃人功，賜號達爾漢。

translations.literal: In winter, for taiji Kenjehe's merit in pursuing and capturing Maoming'an fugitives, he was granted the title Darhan.
translations.idiomatic: That winter taiji Kenjehe was granted the title Darhan for his success in pursuing and capturing fugitives from Maoming'an.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入山海關，擊流賊李自成。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi, he followed in entering Shanhaiguan and attacking the bandit Li Zicheng.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he followed the Qing army through Shanhaiguan and fought the rebel Li Zicheng.

sentences.zh: 五年，詔編所部佐領。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, an edict ordered the registration of zuolings for the banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year an edict registered the banner's zuolings.

sentences.zh: 時內齊、色本卒，以內齊子尚嘉布掌左翼，色本子桑噶爾掌右翼，各授扎薩克貝勒。

translations.literal: At that time Neiji and Seben had died; Neiji's son Shangjiabu was put in charge of the left wing and Seben's son Sangeer of the right wing, and each was granted jasak beile rank.
translations.idiomatic: By then Neiji and Seben had died. Neiji's son Shangjiabu was placed at the head of the left wing and Seben's son Sangeer of the right wing, and each was appointed jasak beile.

sentences.zh: 康熙十四年，察哈爾布林尼叛，且陰煽諸部。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Kangxi, Chakhar Bulunni rebelled and also secretly incited the other banners.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 14 the Chakhar rebel Bulunni rose in revolt and secretly incited other banners.

sentences.zh: 二等台吉根翼什希布以不附逆，封鎮國公。

translations.literal: Second-class taiji Genyishixibu, for not joining the rebellion, was enfeoffed as baron of the state.
translations.idiomatic: Second-class taiji Genyishixibu, who had refused to join the rebellion, was ennobled as baron of the state.

sentences.zh: 後停襲。

translations.literal: Later the inheritance was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The title was later made non-hereditary.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，隨大軍征噶爾丹，二等台吉科克晉、四等台吉袞楚克色爾濟額爾德尼陣歿，俱贈一等台吉，賜號達爾漢。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, following the main army in campaigning against Galdan, second-class taiji Kekejin and fourth-class taiji Günchük Sergelen Erdene fell in battle; both were posthumously granted first-class taiji rank and the title Darhan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year, on campaign against Galdan, second-class taiji Kekejin and fourth-class taiji Günchük Sergelen Erdene were killed in battle. Both were posthumously raised to first-class taiji and granted the title Darhan.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，所部歉收，詔發帑賑之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng, the banner had a poor harvest, and an edict ordered funds from the treasury distributed in relief.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 the banner suffered crop failure, and an edict ordered relief from the treasury.

sentences.zh: 十一年，選兵隨剿噶爾丹策淩，隸敖漢台吉羅卜藏軍。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, selected troops followed in suppressing Galdan Tseren and were attached to the army of Aohan taiji Luobuzang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year selected troops joined the campaign against Galdan Tseren under the command of Aohan taiji Luobuzang.

sentences.zh: 所部二旗，左翼駐齊齊靈花拖羅海山北，右翼駐圖爾山南。

translations.literal: The banner had two wings: the left wing was stationed north of Qiqi Linghua Tuoluo Hai Mountain and the right wing south of Tu'er Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: The banner comprised two wings: the left was headquartered north of Qiqi Linghua Tuoluo Hai Mountain and the right south of Tu'er Mountain.

sentences.zh: 爵四：扎薩克多羅貝勒一，扎薩克多羅達爾漢貝勒一，附鎮國公一，輔國公一。

translations.literal: There were four ranks: one jasak duoluo beile, one jasak duoluo Darhan beile, one supplementary baron of the state, and one auxiliary state duke.
translations.idiomatic: There were four noble ranks: one jasak duoluo beile, one jasak duoluo Darhan beile, one supplementary baron of the state, and one auxiliary state duke.

sentences.zh: 是部產鹼，初禁開取。

translations.literal: This banner produced alkali, and at first mining it was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: The banner produced natural alkali, which at first was forbidden to be extracted.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十一年，都統松壽以部議主開，奏定納課章程，由各旗選派公正蒙員試辦。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year of Guangxu, Governor-General Song Shou, following the board's deliberation favoring opening, memorialized to fix the tax-payment regulations, with each banner selecting upright Mongol officials for trial operation.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 21 Governor-General Song Shou, acting on the board's recommendation to permit extraction, memorialized regulations for tax payment, with each banner selecting upright Mongol officials to manage a trial operation.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，都統廷傑奏，以是部及阿嚕科爾沁墾地置開魯縣，隸赤峰直隸州。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year, Governor-General Ting Jie memorialized that Kailu County should be established on opened lands of this banner and Ar Khorchin and made subordinate to Chifeng Zhili Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year Governor-General Ting Jie memorialized that reclaimed land in this banner and Ar Khorchin should be organized as Kailu County, subordinate to Chifeng Zhili Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 是部左右翼旗各有佐領十六。

translations.literal: This banner's left and right wing banners each had sixteen zuolings.
translations.idiomatic: Each of the banner's left and right wings had sixteen zuolings.

sentences.zh: 阿嚕科爾沁部，在古北口外，至京師千三百四十里。

translations.literal: The Ar Khorchin tribe is beyond Gubeikou, one thousand three hundred forty li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Ar Khorchin banner lay beyond Gubeikou, 1,340 li from the capital.

sentences.zh: 東西距百三十里，南北距四百二十里。

translations.literal: East to west it measures one hundred thirty li; north to south four hundred twenty li.
translations.idiomatic: It measured 130 li from east to west and 420 li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 東紮嚕特，西巴林，南喀爾喀左翼，北烏珠穆沁。

translations.literal: To the east is Jarud; to the west Baarin; to the south Khalkha Left; to the north Ujumqin.
translations.idiomatic: Jarud lay to the east, Baarin to the west, Left Khalkha to the south, and Ujumqin to the north.

sentences.zh: 元太祖弟哈布圖哈薩爾十三傳至圖美尼雅哈齊。

translations.literal: From Khabutu Khasar, younger brother of the Yuan founding emperor, the thirteenth generation reached Tümeni Yahachi.
translations.idiomatic: Tümeni Yahachi was thirteenth in descent from Khabutu Khasar, younger brother of Genghis Khan.

sentences.zh: 子三：長奎蒙克塔斯哈喇，遊牧嫩江，號嫩科爾沁；

translations.literal: He had three sons: the elder Kuimengke Tas Hala grazed on the Nen River and styled himself Nen Khorchin;
translations.idiomatic: He had three sons. The eldest, Kuimengke Tas Hala, grazed along the Nen River and styled his people Nen Khorchin;

sentences.zh: 次巴袞諾顏；

translations.literal: the second Bagun Noyan;
translations.idiomatic: the second was Bagun Noyan;

sentences.zh: 次布林海，遊牧呼倫貝爾。

translations.literal: the third Bulun Hai grazed in Hulun Buir.
translations.idiomatic: the third, Bulun Hai, grazed in Hulun Buir.

sentences.zh: 巴袞諾顏子三：長昆都倫岱青，號所部曰阿嚕科爾沁，以別於嫩科爾沁。

translations.literal: Bagun Noyan had three sons: the eldest Kudunlun Daqing, styled his tribe Ar Khorchin to distinguish it from Nen Khorchin.
translations.idiomatic: Bagun Noyan had three sons. The eldest, Kudunlun Daqing, styled his people Ar Khorchin to distinguish them from Nen Khorchin.

sentences.zh: 子達賚，稱楚琥爾，嗣為部長；

translations.literal: His son Dalai, styled Chuhu'er, succeeded as tribal chief;
translations.idiomatic: His son Dalai, known as Chuhu'er, succeeded as banner chief;

sentences.zh: 次哈貝，子巴圖爾，裔不著；

translations.literal: the second was Habei; his son Batur—descendants not recorded;
translations.idiomatic: the second was Habei, whose son Batur left no recorded posterity;

sentences.zh: 次諾顏泰，子四，號四子部落。

translations.literal: the third was Noyan Tai; he had four sons, styled the Fourth Tribe.
translations.idiomatic: the third, Noyan Tai, had four sons who formed the Fourth Tribe.

sentences.zh: 布林海裔號烏喇特，詳各部傳。

translations.literal: Bulun Hai's descendants styled themselves Urad; details are given in the accounts of each tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Bulun Hai's line took the name Urad; their history is recounted in the separate tribal biographies.

sentences.zh: 阿嚕科爾沁與四子部落、烏喇特、茂明安、翁牛特、阿巴噶、阿巴哈納爾及喀爾喀內外扎薩克統號阿嚕蒙古，初皆服屬於察哈爾。

translations.literal: Ar Khorchin, together with the Fourth Tribe, Urad, Minggan, Ongniud, Abaga, Abahanar, and the inner and outer Khalkha jasaks, were collectively styled Ar Mongol; all initially were subject to Chakhar.
translations.idiomatic: Ar Khorchin, the Fourth Tribe, Urad, Minggan, Ongniud, Abaga, Abahanar, and the inner and outer Khalkha jasaks were collectively known as Ar Mongol, all initially subject to Chakhar.

sentences.zh: 以林丹汗不道，天聰四年，達賚暨子穆彰率屬來歸，命諸貝勒郊迎五里，賜宴。

translations.literal: Because Ligdan Khan was unjust, in the fourth year of Tiancong, Dalai together with his son Muzhang led their followers to submit. The princes were ordered to greet them five li outside the city, and a banquet was granted.
translations.idiomatic: When Ligdan Khan proved tyrannical, in Tiancong 4 (1630) Dalai and his son Muzhang brought their people over to the Qing. The princes were ordered to welcome them five li from the city, and a banquet was held.

sentences.zh: 八年，遣大臣赴碩翁科爾定諸籓牧，以兩白旗外塔拉布拉克遜島為其部界。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, ministers were dispatched to Shuo'engke'er to fix the pastures of the dependencies; Tarabulaq beyond the two White Banners and Xun Island were set as this tribe's boundary.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year ministers went to Shuo'engke'er to demarcate dependency pastures, setting Tarabulaq beyond the two White Banners and Xun Island as the banner's boundary.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，宣諭朝鮮，其部德赫拜達爾齎書從。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde, an envoy was sent to proclaim to Korea; Dehe Baidar'er of the tribe carried the letter along.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1 (1636) an envoy was dispatched to announce Qing policy to Korea, accompanied by Dehe Baidar'er of the banner.

sentences.zh: 遇明皮島兵，狙擊敗之。

translations.literal: They encountered Ming troops from Pi Island, ambushed them, and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: En route they met Ming forces from Pi Island, ambushed them, and routed them.

sentences.zh: 還，得優賚。

translations.literal: On returning, they received generous rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On their return they were richly rewarded.

sentences.zh: 先是阿嚕科爾沁設兩旗，達賚、穆彰各領一。

translations.literal: Previously Ar Khorchin had two banners, Dalai and Muzhang each heading one.
translations.idiomatic: Ar Khorchin had previously been divided into two banners, each led by Dalai and Muzhang.

sentences.zh: 至是始並兩旗為一，以穆彰領之。

translations.literal: At this point the two banners were merged into one, with Muzhang placed in charge.
translations.idiomatic: They were now merged into a single banner under Muzhang.

sentences.zh: 嗣從征朝鮮、瓦爾喀、索倫、喀爾喀，及明濟南、錦州、松山、薊州。

translations.literal: He subsequently followed campaigns against Korea, Warka, Solon, and Khalkha, and against Ming at Jinan, Jinzhou, Songshan, and Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He later joined campaigns in Korea, against the Warka and Solon, in Khalkha, and against Ming at Jinan, Jinzhou, Songshan, and Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入山海關，擊流賊李自成。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi, he followed in entering Shanhaiguan and attacking the bandit Li Zicheng.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 (1644) he marched through Shanhaiguan with the Qing forces and fought Li Zicheng's rebel army.

sentences.zh: 敘功授扎薩克，爵固山貝子。

translations.literal: For merit he was granted jasak rank and enfeoffed as gushan beizi.
translations.idiomatic: For his service he was appointed jasak and ennobled as gushan beizi.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十七年，噶爾丹侵喀爾喀，諭所部兵防蘇尼特汛。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year of Kangxi, Galdan invaded Khalkha, and troops of the tribe were ordered to guard the Sunid posts.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 27 Galdan invaded Khalkha, and the banner's troops were ordered to man the Sunid defensive posts.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，部眾乏食，賜粟賑之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, the people lacked food, and grain was granted to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year the banner suffered food shortages and was granted grain for relief.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，二等台吉棟紐特從征噶爾丹，見賊勢熾，慷慨謂眾曰：「我等受恩深，若稍退，何面目見聖顏乎？」

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, second-class taiji Dongniute joined the campaign against Galdan. Seeing the enemy's strength, he spoke ardently to the assembly: "We have received deep grace; if we retreat even slightly, what face shall we have to see the sacred countenance?"
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year second-class taiji Dongniute joined the campaign against Galdan. Seeing how formidable the enemy was, he told his men: "We owe the emperor a deep debt of gratitude. If we give ground even a little, how can we face him again?"

sentences.zh: 率兵三百趨前戰，皆歿。

translations.literal: He led three hundred troops forward to battle; all perished.
translations.idiomatic: He led three hundred men into the charge; all were killed.

sentences.zh: 三十年，贈一等台吉，世襲達爾漢號。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, he was posthumously granted first-class taiji with a hereditary Darhan title.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year he was posthumously raised to first-class taiji with a hereditary Darhan title.

sentences.zh: 是冬，理籓院議給所部貧戶米穀。

translations.literal: That winter the Lifan Yuan deliberated granting grain to poor households of the tribe.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the Lifan Yuan considered distributing grain to the banner's poor households.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「賞給米穀，應調蒙古駝馬運送。

translations.literal: An instruction said: "In granting grain, Mongol camels and horses should be requisitioned for transport.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor instructed: "Grain relief should be delivered by requisitioning Mongol camels and horses.

sentences.zh: 時值隆冬，輸輓殊艱，恐領米之人不能運到，必致沿邊私糶，不如量米給銀，到彼甚易，貧人得霑實惠。」

translations.literal: It is deep winter, and transport is extremely difficult; I fear those receiving grain cannot move it, which would surely lead to illicit sale along the frontier. It is better to measure the grain and pay silver instead—once there it is very easy, and the poor receive real benefit."
translations.idiomatic: In deep winter haulage is extremely arduous; recipients may be unable to move the grain, inviting illicit sale along the frontier. It would be better to measure the grain and pay silver in its place—silver is easy to carry, and the poor will receive real benefit."

sentences.zh: 三十五年，上親征噶爾丹，偵賊沿克嚕倫河至額哲特圖哈布齊爾地，諭嚴防汛界。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year, the emperor personally campaigned against Galdan. Scouts reported the enemy moving along the Kerulen River to Ejeitu Hubuqir; he ordered strict defense of the border posts.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 35 the emperor led a personal campaign against Galdan. When scouts reported the enemy moving along the Kerulen toward Ejeitu Hubuqir, he ordered tighter border patrols.

sentences.zh: 四十三年，遣大臣往訊盜案，宣諭扎薩克戢所部，務令無盜。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year, a minister was dispatched to investigate a theft case and proclaim to the jasak to restrain his tribe and ensure there were no thefts.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-third year an official was sent to investigate a theft case and instructed the jasak to keep his banner in order and suppress robbery.

sentences.zh: 四十八年，固山額駙巴特瑪妻縣君以屬人不遵令，請獻戶口，諭暫遣官理，後不為例。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year, gushan efuo Batma's wife the xianjun, because her subordinates did not obey orders, requested to surrender her households; she was instructed to send officials to administer them temporarily, not to be made a precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-eighth year Batma, a gushan imperial son-in-law, petitioned through his wife the xianjun to surrender her households because her subordinates would not obey; the court allowed temporary official administration but ruled that this should not become precedent.

sentences.zh: 雍正五年，賜所部貧戶銀。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yongzheng, silver was granted to poor households of the tribe.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 5 silver was distributed to the banner's poor households.

sentences.zh: 九年，從大軍剿噶爾丹策淩。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, he followed the great army in suppressing Galdan Tsewang.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the banner joined the main force against Galdan Tsewang.

sentences.zh: 十三年，遣官齎銀賑饑。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, officials were dispatched carrying silver to relieve famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year officials were sent with silver for famine relief.

sentences.zh: 所部一旗，駐牧琿圖山東，隸昭烏達盟。

translations.literal: The tribe had one banner, pasturing east of Huitu Mountain and subordinate to the Zhaowuda League.
translations.idiomatic: The banner pastured east of Huitu Mountain and belonged to the Zhaowuda League.

sentences.zh: 其爵為扎薩克多羅貝勒，由固山貝子晉襲。

translations.literal: Its rank was jasak duoluo beile, promoted by succession from gushan beizi.
translations.idiomatic: Its chief held the rank of jasak duoluo beile, promoted by hereditary succession from gushan beizi.

sentences.zh: 是部亦產鹼。

translations.literal: This tribe also produces alkali.
translations.idiomatic: The banner also produced natural alkali.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十一年，定蒙員自辦納課章程。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year of Guangxu, regulations were fixed for Mongol officials to manage their own tax payment.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 31 regulations were set for Mongol officials to administer their own tax payments.

sentences.zh: 是部一旗，有佐領五十。

translations.literal: This tribe had one banner with fifty zuolings.
translations.idiomatic: The banner comprised a single division with fifty zuolings.

sentences.zh: 翁牛特部，在古北口外，至京師七百六十里。

translations.literal: The Ongniud tribe is beyond Gubeikou, seven hundred sixty li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Ongniud banner lay beyond Gubeikou, 760 li from the capital.

sentences.zh: 東西距三百里，南北距百六十里。

translations.literal: East to west it measures three hundred li; north to south one hundred sixty li.
translations.idiomatic: It measured 300 li from east to west and 160 li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 東阿嚕科爾沁，西承德府，南喀喇沁及敖漢，北巴林及克什克騰。

translations.literal: To the east is Ar Khorchin; to the west Chengde Prefecture; to the south Kharchin and Aohan; to the north Baarin and Hexigten.
translations.idiomatic: Ar Khorchin lay to the east, Chengde Prefecture to the west, Kharchin and Aohan to the south, and Baarin and Hexigten to the north.

sentences.zh: 元太祖弟諤楚因，稱烏真諾顏。

translations.literal: Öchüjin, younger brother of Genghis Khan, styled Ujen Noyan.
translations.idiomatic: Öchüjin, Genghis Khan's younger brother, was styled Ujen Noyan.

sentences.zh: 其裔蒙克察罕諾顏。

translations.literal: His descendant was Mönke Tsaghan Noyan.
translations.idiomatic: His line continued through Mönke Tsaghan Noyan.

sentences.zh: 有子二：長巴顏岱洪果爾諾顏，號所部曰翁牛特，次巴泰車臣諾顏，別號喀喇齊哩克部，皆稱阿嚕蒙古。

translations.literal: He had two sons: the elder Bayandai Hongguor Noyan styled his tribe Ongniud; the second Btai Sechen Noyan separately styled the Kharachilik tribe; both were called Ar Mongol.
translations.idiomatic: He had two sons. The elder, Bayandai Hongguor Noyan, styled his people Ongniud; the second, Btai Sechen Noyan, founded the separate Kharachilik banner. Both were known as Ar Mongol.

sentences.zh: 巴顏岱洪果爾諾顏再傳至圖蘭，號杜棱汗。

translations.literal: Bayandai Hongguor Noyan passed down two generations to Tülan, styled Dulen Khan.
translations.idiomatic: Two generations after Bayandai Hongguor Noyan, Tülan styled himself Dulen Khan.

sentences.zh: 子七：長遜杜棱，次阿巴噶圖琿台吉，次棟岱青，次班第偉徵，次達拉海諾木齊，次薩揚墨爾根，次本巴楚琥爾巴泰車臣諾顏。

translations.literal: He had seven sons: the eldest Sundulen; the second Abagatu Hui taiji; the third Dongdaiqing; the fourth Bandi Weizheng; the fifth Dalahai Nomuchi; the sixth Sayang Mer-gen; the seventh Benba Chuhu'er Btai Sechen Noyan.
translations.idiomatic: He had seven sons: Sundulen, Abagatu Hui taiji, Dongdaiqing, Bandi Weizheng, Dalahai Nomuchi, Sayang Mer-gen, and Benba Chuhu'er Btai Sechen Noyan.

sentences.zh: 三傳至努綏，子二：長噶爾瑪，次諾密泰岱青。

translations.literal: Three generations later came Nusui, who had two sons: the elder Garmal and the second Nomitai Daqing.
translations.idiomatic: Three generations later Nusui had two sons, Garmal and Nomitai Daqing.

sentences.zh: 皆初服屬於察哈爾。

translations.literal: All were initially subject to Chakhar.
translations.idiomatic: All were initially subject to Chakhar.

sentences.zh: 以林丹汗不道，天聰六年，遜杜棱、棟岱青暨喀喇齊哩克台吉噶爾瑪率屬來歸。

translations.literal: Because Ligdan Khan was unjust, in the sixth year of Tiancong, Sundulen, Dongdaiqing, and Kharachilik taiji Garmal led their followers to submit.
translations.idiomatic: When Ligdan Khan proved tyrannical, in Tiancong 6 Sundulen, Dongdaiqing, and Kharachilik taiji Garmal brought their people over to the Qing.

sentences.zh: 是年，上親征察哈爾，各選兵從。

translations.literal: That year the emperor personally campaigned against Chakhar, and each selected troops to follow.
translations.idiomatic: That year the emperor led a personal campaign against Chakhar, and each chief sent picked troops.

sentences.zh: 林丹汗遁；

translations.literal: Ligdan Khan fled;
translations.idiomatic: Ligdan Khan fled;
