sentences.zh: 復從貝勒阿濟格赴大同、宣府，收察哈爾部眾之竄入明邊者。

translations.literal: They again followed Prince Ajige to Datong and Xuanfu to round up Chakhar people who had fled into the Ming border.
translations.idiomatic: They then followed Prince Ajige to Datong and Xuanfu to collect Chakhar people who had fled into Ming territory.

sentences.zh: 師旋，優賚遣歸。

translations.literal: When the army returned, they were generously rewarded and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned they were richly rewarded and sent home.

sentences.zh: 自是其部稱翁牛特，以喀喇齊哩克附之，不復冠阿嚕舊稱。

translations.literal: From then on the tribe was called Ongniud; Kharachilik was attached to it, and they no longer used the old Ar designation.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the banner was known as Ongniud, with Kharachilik incorporated, and the old Ar name was dropped.

sentences.zh: 七年春，棟岱青、噶爾瑪來朝，班第偉徵等相繼獻駝馬。

translations.literal: In the spring of the seventh year, Dongdaiqing and Garmal came to court; Bandi Weizheng and others successively presented camels and horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the seventh year Dongdaiqing and Garmal came to court, and Bandi Weizheng and others successively presented camels and horses.

sentences.zh: 冬，遜杜棱復率眾來朝。

translations.literal: In winter Sundulen again led his people to court.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Sundulen again led his people to court.

sentences.zh: 八年，遣大臣赴碩翁科爾定諸籓牧，以扈拉瑚、琥呼布哩都為翁牛特部界。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, ministers were dispatched to Shuo'engke'er to fix dependency pastures; Hulahu and Huhubulidu were set as the Ongniud tribe's boundary.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year ministers went to Shuo'engke'er to demarcate pastures, setting Hulahu and Huhubulidu as the Ongniud banner's boundary.

sentences.zh: 是冬，班第偉徵、達拉海諾木齊以越界遊牧罪，議罰駝百、馬千。

translations.literal: That winter Bandi Weizheng and Dalahai Nomuchi were found guilty of cross-border grazing and a penalty of one hundred camels and one thousand horses was proposed.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Bandi Weizheng and Dalahai Nomuchi were convicted of grazing beyond their bounds; a fine of one hundred camels and one thousand horses was proposed.

sentences.zh: 詔從寬，罰十之一。

translations.literal: An edict showed leniency, imposing one tenth.
translations.idiomatic: The court showed leniency and reduced the penalty to one tenth.

sentences.zh: 復以罰奈曼部駝馬命分給遜杜棱、棟岱青。

translations.literal: The camels and horses fined from the Naiman tribe were also ordered distributed to Sundulen and Dongdaiqing.
translations.idiomatic: Camels and horses levied as fines from the Naiman banner were also ordered distributed to Sundulen and Dongdaiqing.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，詔編新部佐領，以遜杜棱掌右翼，爵多羅杜棱郡王；

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde, an edict ordered the organization of zuolings for the new tribe; Sundulen was put in charge of the right wing and enfeoffed as duoluo Dulen junwang;
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1 zuolings were registered for the new banner; Sundulen was placed at the head of the right wing and ennobled as duoluo Dulen junwang;

sentences.zh: 棟岱青掌左翼，子多羅達爾漢岱青，各授扎薩克。

translations.literal: Dongdaiqing was put in charge of the left wing, with the title duoluo Darhan Daqing; each was granted jasak rank.
translations.idiomatic: Dongdaiqing headed the left wing as duoluo Darhan Daqing; each was appointed jasak.

sentences.zh: 三年，喀爾喀扎薩克圖汗擁眾偪歸化城，上親征之，棟岱青、班第偉徵、達拉海諾木齊等以兵會偵，扎薩克圖汗遁，乃還。

translations.literal: In the third year, Khalkha Jasaktu Khan massed troops threatening Guihua City. The emperor personally campaigned; Dongdaiqing, Bandi Weizheng, Dalahai Nomuchi, and others joined in reconnaissance. Jasaktu Khan fled, and they returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Khalkha Jasaktu Khan mustered troops against Guihua City. The emperor marched in person; Dongdaiqing, Bandi Weizheng, Dalahai Nomuchi, and others joined the reconnaissance force. Jasaktu Khan fled and they withdrew.

sentences.zh: 四年，棟岱青率宰桑烏巴什、和尼齊等從大軍征明。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Dongdaiqing led zaisang Ubasi, Honichi, and others with the great army against Ming.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Dongdaiqing led zaisang Ubasi, Honichi, and others on the great campaign against Ming.

sentences.zh: 六年，圍錦州、松山，設伏高橋大路及桑阿爾齋堡，遇杏山逃卒，追擊之，斬獲甚眾。

translations.literal: In the sixth year they besieged Jinzhou and Songshan, setting ambushes on the Gaoqiao main road and at Sang'erzhai fort. Encountering deserters from Xingshan, they pursued and killed and captured in great numbers.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year they besieged Jinzhou and Songshan, laying ambushes on the Gaoqiao road and at Sang'erzhai fort. When they met deserters from Xingshan they pursued them and took many heads and captives.

sentences.zh: 七年，敘功，賜棟岱青、噶爾瑪、和尼齊等布幣有差。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, for merit cloth rewards were granted in varying amounts to Dongdaiqing, Garmal, Honichi, and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Dongdaiqing, Garmal, Honichi, and others received cloth rewards in varying measure for their service.

sentences.zh: 復追議松山掘壕時，宰桑烏巴什以誦經故不親督兵，及暮又失守望罪，論死，詔宥之。

translations.literal: When the Songshan trench-digging was reconsidered, zaisang Ubasi, because he was reciting sutras, did not personally supervise the troops; at dusk he also failed in sentry duty. Sentenced to death, he was pardoned by edict.
translations.idiomatic: A review of the Songshan trench work found that zaisang Ubasi, occupied with sutra recitation, had not personally overseen his men and had failed the evening watch. Though sentenced to death, he was pardoned by edict.

sentences.zh: 達拉海諾木齊及綽克圖巴木布等復從貝勒阿巴泰征明。

translations.literal: Dalahai Nomuchi and Chokitu Bambu and others again followed Prince Abatai against Ming.
translations.idiomatic: Dalahai Nomuchi, Chokitu Bambu, and others again followed Prince Abatai against Ming.

sentences.zh: 八年，來獻俘，賜宴。

translations.literal: In the eighth year they came presenting captives and were granted a banquet.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year they presented captives at court and were feasted.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入山海關，擊流賊李自成，復追敍部將噶勒嘛從征明功，賜號達爾漢。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi, he followed in entering Shanhaiguan and attacking the bandit Li Zicheng; the merits of the subordinate general Gelema from the Ming campaign were again reviewed, and the Darhan title was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he marched through Shanhaiguan against Li Zicheng's rebels; the merits of his subordinate Gelema from the Ming campaign were reconsidered and he was granted the Darhan title.

sentences.zh: 康熙十五年，以剿逆籓吳三桂，詔選兵赴河南駐防。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Kangxi, to suppress the rebel Wu Sangui, an edict ordered selected troops sent to garrison Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 15, during the campaign against the rebel Wu Sangui, selected troops were ordered to garrison Henan.

sentences.zh: 十六年，調荊州。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year they were transferred to Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year they were transferred to Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 十八年，撤還。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year they were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year they were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，以其部多盜，諭撫眾及弭盜法。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, because the tribe had many thieves, instructions were issued on pacifying the people and suppressing theft.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, with theft rampant in the banner, the court issued instructions on pacifying the people and suppressing banditry.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，上閱兵盧溝橋，命其部來朝人從觀。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year the emperor reviewed troops at Lugou Bridge and ordered visitors from the tribe to observe.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year the emperor reviewed troops at Lugou Bridge and invited the banner's visitors at court to watch.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，選兵赴蘇尼特汛防禦噶爾丹。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, selected troops were sent to the Sunid posts to defend against Galdan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year picked troops were posted to the Sunid line against Galdan.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，所部乏食，遣官往賑。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year the people lacked food, and officials were dispatched for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year food shortages prompted an official relief mission.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，上親征噶爾丹，詔徵兵五百，運中路軍糈給器糒。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year the emperor personally campaigned against Galdan; an edict requisitioned five hundred troops to transport mid-route army provisions and supplies.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 35 the emperor campaigned against Galdan in person and requisitioned five hundred men to haul provisions and supplies for the central route army.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，朔漠平，賚運糧兵銀。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year the northern desert was pacified, and silver was granted to the grain-transport troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year, with the northern frontier pacified, the grain-transport troops were rewarded with silver.

sentences.zh: 五十六年，理籓院奏翁牛特及克什克騰諸扎薩克請令公勘地址有越界伐木者論罪，從之。

translations.literal: In the fifty-sixth year the Lifan Yuan memorialized that jasaks of Ongniud and Hexigten requested that officials be sent to survey boundaries and punish cross-border logging; the request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-sixth year Ongniud and Hexigten jasaks asked that officials survey their boundaries and punish illegal cross-border logging; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 雍正五年，賜銀賑所屬貧戶。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yongzheng, silver was granted to relieve poor subjects.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 5 silver was distributed to relieve the banner's poor.

sentences.zh: 九年，隨大軍剿噶爾丹策淩。

translations.literal: In the ninth year they followed the great army in suppressing Galdan Tsewang.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year they joined the main force against Galdan Tsewang.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十年，從征達瓦齊。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Qianlong, they followed the campaign against Dawachi.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 20 they joined the campaign against Dawachi.

sentences.zh: 所部二旗，右翼駐英什爾哈齊特呼朗，左翼駐扎喇峰西。

translations.literal: The tribe had two banners: the right wing pastured at Yingshi'erhaqite Hulang, the left wing west of Zhala Peak.
translations.idiomatic: The banner was split into two divisions: the right wing pastured at Yingshi'erhaqite Hulang, the left west of Zhala Peak.

sentences.zh: 爵四，扎薩克多羅杜棱郡王一，附固山貝子一，鎮國公一，扎薩克多羅達爾漢岱青貝勒一。

translations.literal: There were four ranks: one jasak duoluo Dulen junwang, one attached gushan beizi, one defender-of-the-state duke, and one jasak duoluo Darhan Daqing beile.
translations.idiomatic: Four noble ranks were held: jasak duoluo Dulen junwang, an attached gushan beizi, a defender-of-the-state duke, and jasak duoluo Darhan Daqing beile.

sentences.zh: 光緒十七年，金丹道匪之變，賊渠李國珍等擾是部，焚王府，踞烏丹城，即元全甯路治，實熱河北路門戶。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Guangxu, during the Jindao bandit uprising, bandit chief Li Guozhen and others disturbed this tribe, burned the princely mansion, and occupied Wudan city—the seat of the Yuan Quanning Circuit, in truth the gateway of Rehe's north route.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 17, during the Jindao uprising, the bandit chief Li Guozhen and his followers raided the banner, burned the princely residence, and seized Wudan city—the former seat of Yuan Quanning Circuit and the strategic gateway to Rehe's northern route.

sentences.zh: 葉志超遣副將潘萬才等率軍先克之，餘遂迎刃而解。

translations.literal: Ye Zhichao dispatched Vice General Pan Wancai and others with troops to capture it first; the rest then fell easily.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Zhichao sent Vice General Pan Wancai and others to retake the city first; the remaining strongholds then collapsed with little resistance.

sentences.zh: 是部二旗，蹂躪均重。

translations.literal: Both banners of the tribe suffered heavy devastation.
translations.idiomatic: Both wings of the banner were heavily ravaged.

sentences.zh: 事平，賑恤之。

translations.literal: After the matter was settled, relief was granted.
translations.idiomatic: After order was restored relief was granted.

sentences.zh: 左翼有佐領二十，右翼有佐領三十八。

translations.literal: The left wing had twenty zuolings; the right wing had thirty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: The left wing had twenty zuolings and the right thirty-eight.

sentences.zh: 克什克騰部，在古北口外，至京師八百有十里。

translations.literal: The Hexigten tribe is beyond Gubeikou, eight hundred ten li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Hexigten banner lay beyond Gubeikou, 810 li from the capital.

sentences.zh: 東西距三百三十四里，南北距三百五十七里。

translations.literal: East to west it measures three hundred thirty-four li; north to south three hundred fifty-seven li.
translations.idiomatic: It measured 334 li from east to west and 357 li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 東翁牛特及巴林，西浩齊特及察哈爾正藍旗牧廠，南翁牛特，北烏珠穆沁。

translations.literal: To the east are Ongniud and Baarin; to the west Haoqite and the Chakhar Plain Blue Banner pasture; to the south Ongniud; to the north Ujumqin.
translations.idiomatic: Ongniud and Baarin lay to the east, Haoqite and the Chakhar Plain Blue Banner pasture to the west, Ongniud to the south, and Ujumqin to the north.

sentences.zh: 元太祖十六世孫鄂齊爾博羅特，再傳至沙喇勒達，稱墨爾根諾顏，號所部曰克什克騰。

translations.literal: Öchir Bolot, sixteenth-generation descendant of Genghis Khan, passed down two generations to Shalada, styled Morgen Noyan, and styled his tribe Hexigten.
translations.idiomatic: Öchir Bolot, sixteenth-generation scion of Genghis Khan, was succeeded two generations later by Shalada, who styled himself Morgen Noyan and named his people Hexigten.

sentences.zh: 子達爾瑪，有子三：長索諾木，次巴本，次圖壘。

translations.literal: His son Darma had three sons: the eldest Sonom, the second Baben, and the third Tülei.
translations.idiomatic: His son Darma had three sons: Sonom, Baben, and Tülei.

sentences.zh: 服屬於察哈爾。

translations.literal: They were subject to Chakhar.
translations.idiomatic: They were subject to Chakhar.

sentences.zh: 天聰八年，索諾木率屬來歸。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tiancong, Sonom led his followers to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 8 Sonom brought his people over to the Qing.

sentences.zh: 崇德六年，台吉沙哩、博羅和、雲敦等奉命赴董家、喜峰諸口偵明兵，俘斬甚眾。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Chongde, taijis Shali, Boluohe, Yundun, and others were ordered to go to Dongjia, Xifeng, and other passes to scout Ming troops; they captured and killed in great numbers.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 6 taijis Shali, Boluohe, Yundun, and others were sent to scout Ming forces at Dongjia, Xifeng, and other passes and took many prisoners and heads.

sentences.zh: 順治九年，詔編所部佐領，以索諾木領之，授扎薩克。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Shunzhi, an edict ordered the organization of zuolings for the tribe; Sonom was put in charge and granted jasak rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 9 the banner's zuolings were registered with Sonom as jasak.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十六年，上閱兵盧溝橋，命其部來朝人從觀。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year of Kangxi the emperor reviewed troops at Lugou Bridge and ordered visitors from the tribe to observe.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 26 the emperor reviewed troops at Lugou Bridge and invited the banner's visitors at court to watch.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，噶爾丹侵喀爾喀，詔選兵防蘇尼特汛。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, Galdan invaded Khalkha; an edict ordered selected troops to guard the Sunid posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year Galdan invaded Khalkha and picked troops were posted to the Sunid line.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，四等台吉穆倫噶爾弼以偵擊噶爾丹功，晉一等台吉。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, fourth-class taiji Mulun Garbi, for merit in scouting and attacking Galdan, was promoted to first-class taiji.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year fourth-class taiji Mulun Garbi was raised to first-class taiji for his scouting and fighting against Galdan.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，上親征噶爾丹。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year the emperor personally campaigned against Galdan.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 35 the emperor led a personal campaign against Galdan.

sentences.zh: 凱旋，以其部設站兵無誤驛務，賚銀幣。

translations.literal: Returning in triumph, his tribe was posted as relay-station troops so the postal service would run without mishap, and silver and coin were granted.
translations.idiomatic: On their triumphant return the banner was assigned relay-station troops to keep the courier routes running smoothly, and silver and coin were granted in reward.

sentences.zh: 雍正五年，賜銀賑其屬貧戶。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yongzheng, silver was granted to relieve the poor households of his subjects.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 5 silver was distributed to relieve the banner's poor.

sentences.zh: 所部一旗，駐牧吉拉巴斯峰，隸昭烏達盟。

translations.literal: The tribe had one banner, pastured at Jilabas Peak, and was subordinate to the Zhaowuda League.
translations.idiomatic: The banner comprised a single division pastured at Jilabas Peak under the Zhaowuda League.

sentences.zh: 其爵為扎薩克一等台吉。

translations.literal: Its rank was jasak first-class taiji.
translations.idiomatic: Its chief held the rank of jasak first-class taiji.

sentences.zh: 是部墾事最早。

translations.literal: This tribe was earliest in reclamation.
translations.idiomatic: This banner was among the earliest to take up land reclamation.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶中，設白岔巡檢治之。

translations.literal: In the Jiaqing era, a Baicha sub-prefect was established to govern it.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jiaqing reign a Baicha sub-prefect was posted to administer the area.

sentences.zh: 同治中，回匪東竄熱河，設戍其地。

translations.literal: In the Tongzhi era, Muslim rebels fled east into Rehe, and a garrison was posted in the area.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tongzhi reign Muslim rebels fled east into Rehe, and troops were garrisoned there.

sentences.zh: 又經棚當直隸多倫諾爾廳東北，商民萃處，號稱蕃盛。

translations.literal: There was also a market shed northeast of Zhili's Duolun Nuor office where merchants gathered, and it was called flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: A market fair northeast of Zhili's Duolun Nuor office also drew merchants together and was known as a thriving trading center.

sentences.zh: 光緒十七年，金丹道匪之變，是部曾以兵協剿烏丹城等處之匪，得捷。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Guangxu, during the Jindao bandit uprising, this tribe once sent troops to join in suppressing bandits at Wudan city and other places and achieved victory.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 17, during the Jindao uprising, the banner sent troops to help suppress bandits at Wudan city and elsewhere and won a victory.

sentences.zh: 有佐領十。

translations.literal: There were ten zuolings.
translations.idiomatic: It had ten zuolings.

sentences.zh: 喀爾喀左翼部，在喜峰口外，至京師千二百有十里。

translations.literal: The Khalkha Left tribe is beyond Xifeng Pass, one thousand two hundred ten li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Left Khalkha banner lay beyond Xifeng Pass, 1,210 li from the capital.

sentences.zh: 東西距百二十五里，南北距二百三十里。

translations.literal: East to west it measures one hundred twenty-five li; north to south two hundred thirty li.
translations.idiomatic: It measured 125 li from east to west and 230 li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 東科爾沁，西柰曼，南土默特，北紮嚕特及翁牛特。

translations.literal: To the east is Khorchin; to the west Naiman; to the south Tumed; to the north Jarud and Ongniud.
translations.idiomatic: Khorchin lay to the east, Naiman to the west, Tumed to the south, and Jarud and Ongniud to the north.

sentences.zh: 元太祖十六世孫格哷森劄紮賚爾琿台吉居杭愛山，始號喀爾喀。

translations.literal: Galsangja Jarai Hün Taiji, sixteenth-generation descendant of the Yuan founding emperor, dwelt on the Khangai Mountains and first styled himself Khalkha.
translations.idiomatic: Galsangja Jarai Hün Taiji, sixteenth-generation scion of Genghis Khan, lived on the Khangai Mountains and first took the name Khalkha.

sentences.zh: 有子七，部族繁衍，分東、西、中三路，以三汗掌之。

translations.literal: He had seven sons; the tribe multiplied and was divided into eastern, western, and central routes, each ruled by one of three khans.
translations.idiomatic: He had seven sons. As the tribe grew it was divided into eastern, western, and central branches, each governed by one of three khans.

sentences.zh: 其長子阿什海達爾漢諾顏。

translations.literal: His eldest son was Ashihai Darhan Noyan.
translations.idiomatic: His eldest son was Ashihai Darhan Noyan.

sentences.zh: 生子二：長巴顏達喇，為西路扎薩克圖汗祖；

translations.literal: He begot two sons: the elder Bayan Dara, ancestor of the Western Route Zasagtu Khan;
translations.idiomatic: He had two sons. The elder, Bayan Dara, was ancestor of the Western Route Zasagtu Khan;

sentences.zh: 次圖捫達喇岱青，子碩壘烏巴什琿台吉。

translations.literal: the younger Timen Dara Daqing, whose son was Shulei Ubashi Hun Taiji.
translations.idiomatic: the younger, Timen Dara Daqing, whose son was Shulei Ubashi Hun Taiji.

sentences.zh: 生子三：長俄木布額爾德尼，次杭圖岱，次袞布伊勒登，皆為喀爾喀西路台吉，隸扎薩克圖汗。

translations.literal: He begot three sons: the elder Ombu Erdeni, the second Hangtu Tai, and the third Günb Ildeng; all were Khalkha Western Route taijis subordinate to the Zasagtu Khan.
translations.idiomatic: He had three sons: Ombu Erdeni, Hangtu Tai, and Günb Ildeng, all Khalkha Western Route taijis under the Zasagtu Khan.

sentences.zh: 康熙三年，袞布伊勒登以其汗旺舒克為同族羅卜藏台吉額璘沁所戕，部眾潰，窮無依，乃越瀚海來歸。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kangxi, because his khan Wangshuk was killed by his clansman Lobzang Taiji Erincin, Günb Ildeng's followers scattered and, destitute and without support, crossed the desert sea to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 3 Günb Ildeng's khan Wangshuk was killed by his clansman Lobzang Taiji Erincin. His people scattered and, left destitute, crossed the Gobi to submit to the Qing.

sentences.zh: 先是喀爾喀中路土謝圖汗下臺吉本塔爾攜眾內附，封扎薩克親王爵，駐牧張家口外。

translations.literal: Earlier, Bentar, a taiji under the Khalkha Middle Route Tüshe Tu Khan, had brought his followers to submit internally and was enfeoffed as jasak prince, pasturing beyond Zhangjiakou.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Bentar, a taiji under the Khalkha Middle Route Tüshe Tu Khan, had brought his people over to the Qing and was enfeoffed as jasak prince, with pastures beyond Zhangjiakou.

sentences.zh: 至是詔袞布伊勒登扎薩克多羅貝勒賜牧喜峰口外察罕和碩圖，以所居地分東西，故本塔爾稱喀爾喀右翼，袞布伊勒登稱喀爾喀左翼。

translations.literal: At this time an edict granted Günb Ildeng the rank of jasak duoluo beile and pastures at Chaghan Hushitu beyond Xifeng Pass. Because their dwelling places were divided east and west, Bentar was called Khalkha Right and Günb Ildeng Khalkha Left.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then made Günb Ildeng jasak duoluo beile and granted him pastures at Chaghan Hushitu beyond Xifeng Pass. Their lands were divided into eastern and western sections, so Bentar was styled Right Khalkha and Günb Ildeng Left Khalkha.

sentences.zh: 蓋自國初以來，喀爾喀相繼歸誠，名凡三：曰舊喀爾喀，歸誠最早，後編入蒙古八旗；

translations.literal: From the founding of the dynasty Khalkha had submitted in succession, and the name occurred in three forms: Old Khalkha, which submitted earliest and was later incorporated into the Mongol Eight Banners;
translations.idiomatic: Since the dynasty's founding Khalkha groups had submitted in succession under three names: Old Khalkha, which came over earliest and was later enrolled in the Mongol Eight Banners;

sentences.zh: 曰內喀爾喀，即今隸內扎薩克之喀爾喀左右翼二部；

translations.literal: Inner Khalkha, namely the present Left and Right Khalkha tribes subordinate to Inner Jasak;
translations.idiomatic: Inner Khalkha, the present Left and Right Khalkha banners under Inner Jasak;

sentences.zh: 曰外喀爾喀，其歸誠較後，即今隸外扎薩克之喀爾喀土謝圖汗、車臣汗、扎薩克圖汗、賽因諾顏四部。

translations.literal: and Outer Khalkha, which submitted somewhat later, namely the present four tribes of the Khalkha Tüshe Tu Khan, Setsen Khan, Zasagtu Khan, and Sayin Noyan subordinate to Outer Jasak.
translations.idiomatic: and Outer Khalkha, which submitted later—the present four banners of the Tüshe Tu Khan, Setsen Khan, Zasagtu Khan, and Sayin Noyan under Outer Jasak.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，以額魯特台吉噶爾丹侵喀爾喀土謝圖汗、車臣汗、扎薩克圖汗，所居皆被掠，先後乞降。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, because the Eleuth taiji Galdan invaded the Khalkha Tüshe Tu Khan, Setsen Khan, and Zasagtu Khan and all their dwelling places were plundered, they successively begged to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year Galdan of the Eleuths invaded the Khalkha Tüshe Tu Khan, Setsen Khan, and Zasagtu Khan, plundering their territories until all three successively sought Qing protection.

sentences.zh: 詔袞布伊勒登備兵要汛，偵禦噶爾丹。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Günb Ildeng to prepare troops at key posts and scout to defend against Galdan.
translations.idiomatic: Günb Ildeng was ordered to ready troops at strategic posts and scout against Galdan.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，上由克嚕倫河親征，諭其部選兵赴烏勒輝聽調。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year the emperor personally campaigned from the Kerulen River and instructed the tribe to select troops to go to Ulerhui and await orders.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 35 the emperor led a personal campaign from the Kerulen River and ordered the banner to send picked troops to Ulerhui awaiting dispatch.

sentences.zh: 噶爾丹敗遁，撤兵還。

translations.literal: Galdan was defeated and fled; the troops were withdrawn and returned.
translations.idiomatic: After Galdan was defeated and fled, the troops were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，所屬歉收，賜帑賑之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng, his subjects suffered a poor harvest, and treasury funds were granted for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 a poor harvest prompted treasury relief for the banner's people.

sentences.zh: 九年，大軍剿噶爾丹策淩，選兵赴歸化城駐防。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, when the great army suppressed Galdan Tsewang, selected troops were sent to garrison Guihua city.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year picked troops were posted to Guihua city when the main force moved against Galdan Tsewang.

sentences.zh: 尋以護外扎薩克遊牧，移駐克嚕倫河。

translations.literal: Soon afterward, to protect the pastures of Outer Jasak, they were moved to garrison the Kerulen River.
translations.idiomatic: They were soon shifted to the Kerulen River to protect Outer Jasak grazing lands.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初撤之。

translations.literal: In the early Qianlong reign they were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Qianlong reign the garrison was withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 所部一旗，駐察罕和碩圖。

translations.literal: The tribe had one banner, stationed at Chaghan Hushitu.
translations.idiomatic: The banner comprised a single division headquartered at Chaghan Hushitu.

sentences.zh: 其爵為扎薩克多羅貝勒。

translations.literal: Its rank was jasak duoluo beile.
translations.idiomatic: Its chief held the rank of jasak duoluo beile.

sentences.zh: 有佐領一。

translations.literal: There was one zuoling.
translations.idiomatic: It had one zuoling.

sentences.zh: 是部與敖漢、柰曼、巴林、翁牛特、紮嚕特、喀爾喀左翼、阿嚕科爾沁七部十一旗，統盟於卓索圖。

translations.literal: This tribe, together with Aohan, Naiman, Baarin, Ongniud, Jarud, Khalkha Left, and Ar Khorchin—seven tribes in eleven banners—was united in the Juu Uda League.
translations.idiomatic: This banner, together with Aohan, Naiman, Baarin, Ongniud, Jarud, Left Khalkha, and Ar Khorchin—seven tribes in eleven banners—was grouped under the Juu Uda League.

sentences.zh: 道光末籌海防，咸豐中剿粵匪，皆徵其兵。

translations.literal: At the end of the Daoguang reign coastal defenses were planned; in the Xianfeng reign Cantonese rebels were suppressed; in both cases its troops were requisitioned.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Daoguang reign its troops were called up for coastal defense, and during the Xianfeng reign they were requisitioned to suppress the Cantonese rebels.

sentences.zh: 至同治初，科爾沁親王僧格林沁陣亡，乃撤歸。

translations.literal: By the beginning of the Tongzhi reign, after Khorchin Prince Sengge Rinchen fell in battle, they were withdrawn and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Tongzhi reign, after Khorchin Prince Sengge Rinchen was killed in battle, the troops were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 清代蒙古留京王公，以是盟與哲里木、卓索圖為多，大都額駙子孫。

translations.literal: Among Mongol princes who remained in Beijing during the Qing, those from this league together with Jirem and Juu Uda were the most numerous; most were descendants of imperial sons-in-law.
translations.idiomatic: Among Mongol nobles who resided in Beijing during the Qing, those from this league together with Jirem and Juu Uda predominated; most were descendants of imperial sons-in-law.

sentences.zh: 錫林郭勒、烏察布、伊克昭三盟則鮮見焉。

translations.literal: The three leagues of Xilin Gol, Ulan Buud, and Ike Juu were rarely seen there.
translations.idiomatic: Nobles from the Xilin Gol, Ulan Buud, and Ike Juu leagues were rarely seen at court.

sentences.zh: 烏珠穆沁部，在古北口外，至京師千一百六十三里。

translations.literal: The Ujumqin tribe is beyond Gubeikou, one thousand one hundred sixty-three li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Ujumqin banner lay beyond Gubeikou, 1,163 li from the capital.

sentences.zh: 東西距三百六十里，南北距四百二十五里。

translations.literal: East to west it measures three hundred sixty li; north to south four hundred twenty-five li.
translations.idiomatic: It measured 360 li from east to west and 425 li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 東索倫，西浩齊特，南巴林，北瀚海。

translations.literal: To the east is Solon; to the west Haoqite; to the south Baarin; to the north the desert sea.
translations.idiomatic: Solon lay to the east, Haoqite to the west, Baarin to the south, and the Gobi to the north.

sentences.zh: 元太祖十六世孫圖嚕博羅特由杭愛山徙牧瀚海南，子博第阿喇克繼之。

translations.literal: Tülu Bolot, sixteenth-generation descendant of the Yuan founding emperor, moved from the Khangai Mountains to pasture south of the desert sea; his son Boti Alak succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: Tülu Bolot, sixteenth-generation scion of Genghis Khan, moved from the Khangai Mountains to graze south of the Gobi; he was succeeded by his son Boti Alak.

sentences.zh: 有子三，分牧而處。

translations.literal: He had three sons, who pastured separately and dwelt apart.
translations.idiomatic: He had three sons who split off to graze in separate territories.

sentences.zh: 長庫登汗，詳浩齊特部傳。

translations.literal: The elder was Kuden Khan; see the Haoqite tribal biography.
translations.idiomatic: The eldest was Kuden Khan; see the Haoqite tribal biography.

sentences.zh: 次庫克齊圖墨爾根台吉，詳蘇尼特部傳。

translations.literal: The second was Kukchi Morgen Taiji; see the Sunid tribal biography.
translations.idiomatic: The second was Kukchi Morgen Taiji; see the Sunid tribal biography.

sentences.zh: 次翁袞都喇爾，號其部曰烏珠穆沁。

translations.literal: The third was Ongon Doral, who styled his tribe Ujumqin.
translations.idiomatic: The third, Ongon Doral, styled his people Ujumqin.

sentences.zh: 子五：長綽克圖，號巴圖爾諾顏；

translations.literal: He had five sons: the elder Choktu, styled Batur Noyan;
translations.idiomatic: He had five sons. The eldest, Choktu, was styled Batur Noyan;

sentences.zh: 次巴雅，號賽音冰圖諾顏；

translations.literal: the second Baya, styled Sayin Bingtu Noyan;
translations.idiomatic: the second, Baya, was styled Sayin Bingtu Noyan;

sentences.zh: 次納延泰，號伊勒登諾顏；

translations.literal: the third Nayan Tai, styled Ildeng Noyan;
translations.idiomatic: the third, Nayan Tai, was styled Ildeng Noyan;

sentences.zh: 次彰錦，號達爾漢諾顏。

translations.literal: the fourth Zhangjin, styled Darhan Noyan.
translations.idiomatic: the fourth, Zhangjin, was styled Darhan Noyan.

sentences.zh: 皆早卒。

translations.literal: All died early.
translations.idiomatic: All four died young.

sentences.zh: 次多爾濟，號車臣濟農，與察哈爾同族，為所屬。

translations.literal: The fifth was Dorji, styled Setsen Jiyang, of the same clan as Chakhar and subject to it.
translations.idiomatic: The fifth, Dorji, styled Setsen Jiyang, belonged to the same clan as Chakhar and was subject to it.

sentences.zh: 以林丹汗不道，多爾濟偕綽克圖子色棱徙牧瀚海北，依喀爾喀。

translations.literal: Because Ligdan Khan was unjust, Dorji together with Choktu's son Seleng moved to pasture north of the desert sea and depended on Khalkha.
translations.idiomatic: When Ligdan Khan proved tyrannical, Dorji and Choktu's son Seleng moved north of the Gobi to graze under Khalkha protection.

sentences.zh: 天聰九年，大軍收服察哈爾，多爾濟偕喀爾喀部車臣汗碩壘、浩齊特部策夌伊勒登土謝圖、蘇尼特部叟塞巴圖魯濟農、阿巴噶部都思噶爾扎薩克圖巴圖爾濟農等表貢方物。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Tiancong, after the great army subdued Chakhar, Dorji together with Khalkha Setsen Khan Shulei, Haoqite Tsewang Ildeng Tüshe Tu, Sunid Suusai Batur Jiyang, Abaga Dusigar Zasagtu Batur Jiyang, and others presented tribute goods in memorial.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 9, after the Qing subdued Chakhar, Dorji joined Khalkha Setsen Khan Shulei, Haoqite Tsewang Ildeng Tüshe Tu, Sunid Suusai Batur Jiyang, Abaga Dusigar Zasagtu Batur Jiyang, and others in presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，命舊自察哈爾來歸之偉宰桑等齎敕往諭，遂偕其使納木渾津等至。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde, Wei Zaisang and others who had formerly come from Chakhar to submit were ordered to carry edicts to proclaim the message; they then came together with his envoy Namkhunjin and others.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1 Wei Zaisang and others who had earlier come over from Chakhar were sent with imperial edicts to proclaim the court's will, and they arrived together with his envoy Namkhunjin and others.

sentences.zh: 自是貢物不絕。

translations.literal: From this time tribute goods were unceasing.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute thereafter continued without interruption.

sentences.zh: 二年八月，台吉伊什喀布、烏喇垓增格、阿津、鏗特克等來貢，賚冠服、甲胄、弓矢、布幣。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year, taijis Ishkab, Urakai Zengge, Ajin, Kentek, and others came to present tribute and were granted caps and robes, armor, bows and arrows, and cloth and coin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the second year taijis Ishkab, Urakai Zengge, Ajin, Kentek, and others presented tribute and received caps and robes, armor, bows and arrows, and cloth and coin.

sentences.zh: 十一月，多爾濟、色棱各率屬由克嚕倫來歸。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Dorji and Seleng each led their followers to submit from the Kerulen.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Dorji and Seleng each brought their people over from the Kerulen.

sentences.zh: 三年，喀爾喀扎薩克圖汗擁眾偪歸化城，上統師親征，多爾濟、色棱以兵會偵，扎薩克圖汗遁，乃還。

translations.literal: In the third year the Khalkha Zasagtu Khan massed his followers and pressed upon Guihua city; the emperor personally led the army in campaign. Dorji and Seleng joined with troops to scout; the Zasagtu Khan fled, and they then returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year the Khalkha Zasagtu Khan massed his forces against Guihua city and the emperor marched in person. Dorji and Seleng joined the scouting force; when the Zasagtu Khan fled, they withdrew.

sentences.zh: 賜貢馬台吉巴甘冠服、鞓帶。

translations.literal: The tribute-horse taiji Bagan was granted caps and robes and a girdle.
translations.idiomatic: Bagan, the taiji who had presented horses in tribute, was granted caps and robes and a girdle.

sentences.zh: 五年，賜來朝台吉固穆、塔布囊阿哈圖等蟒服、采幣。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the visiting taijis Gumu, tabunang Ahatur, and others were granted python robes and colored coin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the visiting taijis Gumu, tabunang Ahatur, and others received python robes and colored coin.

sentences.zh: 六年，詔授多爾濟扎薩克和碩車臣親王。

translations.literal: In the sixth year an edict appointed Dorji jasak hoshu Setsen prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Dorji was appointed jasak hoshu Setsen prince.

sentences.zh: 順治三年，詔授色棱扎薩克多羅額爾德尼貝勒。

translations.literal: In the third year of Shunzhi, an edict appointed Seleng jasak duoluo Erdeni beile.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 3 Seleng was appointed jasak duoluo Erdeni beile.

sentences.zh: 以多爾濟掌左翼，色棱掌右翼。

translations.literal: Dorji was put in charge of the left wing and Seleng of the right wing.
translations.idiomatic: Dorji was placed at the head of the left wing and Seleng at the head of the right.

sentences.zh: 是年大軍剿蘇尼特部騰機思，至喀爾喀，以多爾濟屬達喇海鄉導功，賜號達爾漢。

translations.literal: That year the great army suppressed Tenggis of the Sunid tribe and reached Khalkha. Because Dorji's subordinate Darakhai guided them as a local expert, he was granted the designation Darhan.
translations.idiomatic: That year the main force suppressed Tenggis of the Sunid tribe and marched into Khalkha. Dorji's subordinate Darakhai guided them through the country and was granted the title Darhan.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十年，以所部牧鄰喀爾喀，因互竊駝馬，王大臣等遵旨議邊汛形勝處各屯兵百許，按旗設哨，嗣後扎薩克能撫眾戢盜者予敘，否則論罪。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Kangxi, because the tribe's pastures bordered Khalkha and there was mutual theft of camels and horses, princes and ministers followed the imperial instruction and deliberated that at each strategic border post about one hundred troops should be stationed and sentries set by banner. Thereafter jasaks who could pacify their people and suppress thieves would be rewarded, otherwise punished.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 20, with the banner's pastures bordering Khalkha and camel and horse theft rife between them, the court ordered roughly one hundred troops garrisoned at each strategic border post with sentries posted by banner. Jasaks who kept their people in order and suppressed banditry would be rewarded; those who failed would be punished.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，噶爾丹侵喀爾喀，遣大臣赴烏珠穆沁宣諭扎薩克等防汛。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, Galdan invaded Khalkha; a minister was dispatched to Ujumqin to proclaim instructions to the jasaks and others on flood-season defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year Galdan invaded Khalkha and a minister was sent to Ujumqin to instruct the jasaks on border defense.

sentences.zh: 三十年，阿巴噶台吉奔塔爾首烏珠穆沁台吉車根等叛附噶爾丹，語涉扎薩克王素達尼妻。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, Abaga taiji Bental led Ujumqin taiji Chegen and others to rebel and join Galdan; their words implicated the wife of Jasak Prince Sudani.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year Abaga taiji Bental led Ujumqin taiji Chegen and others in rebellion and joined Galdan; their statements implicated Jasak Prince Sudani's wife.

sentences.zh: 命大臣往勘，得車根等私給噶爾丹駝馬，又令部校阿爾塔等往通信狀，罪應死。

translations.literal: A minister was ordered to go and investigate. It was found that Chegen and others had privately given camels and horses to Galdan and also sent banner officers Alta and others to communicate with him; the crime warranted death.
translations.idiomatic: A minister was sent to investigate and found that Chegen and others had secretly supplied Galdan with camels and horses and dispatched banner officers including Alta to communicate with him—crimes punishable by death.

sentences.zh: 素達尼妻預知，應削封號、奪所屬人戶。

translations.literal: Sudani's wife had foreknowledge; she should be stripped of her title and have her subject households confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Sudani's wife had foreknowledge of the plot and should be stripped of her title and lose her subject households.

sentences.zh: 素達尼已故，應除爵。

translations.literal: Sudani was already deceased; his rank should be removed.
translations.idiomatic: Sudani was already dead and his rank should be abolished.

sentences.zh: 議上，詔治車根等罪，免奪人戶。

translations.literal: When the deliberation was submitted, an edict ordered Chegen and others punished for their crimes but exempted the confiscation of subject households.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was submitted, the court ordered Chegen and others punished but exempted the confiscation of subject households.

sentences.zh: 素達尼未預謀，免除爵，襲如初。

translations.literal: Sudani had not premeditated the plot; he was exempted from removal of rank and inheritance proceeded as before.
translations.idiomatic: Because Sudani had not plotted the rebellion, his rank was preserved and succession continued as before.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，素達尼弟協理台吉烏達喇希妻以烏達喇希證車根等從逆狀，乞予敘。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, the wife of Sudani's younger brother, assistant taiji Udashi, because Udashi had proved Chegen and others' rebellious conduct, requested a reward.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year the wife of Sudani's younger brother, assistant taiji Udashi, petitioned for a reward because Udashi had testified to Chegen and others' rebellion.

sentences.zh: 理籓院議烏達喇希故，應贈輔國公，令子袞布紮偵襲，從之。

translations.literal: The Lifan Yuan deliberated that because Udashi was deceased, he should posthumously be granted auxiliary state duke, and his son Günb was ordered to inherit the scout duty; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The Lifan Yuan recommended that Udashi, being deceased, be posthumously granted auxiliary state duke and that his son Günb inherit his scout duties; the recommendation was approved.

sentences.zh: 後停襲。

translations.literal: Later the inheritance was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The inheritance was later discontinued.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，噶爾丹復侵喀爾喀，詔所部選兵駐汛。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year Galdan again invaded Khalkha; an edict ordered the tribe to select troops to garrison the posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year Galdan again invaded Khalkha and the banner was ordered to post picked troops along the border.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，偵噶爾丹至額哲特圖，哈卜濟爾赴烏爾輝聽調。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year scouts reported Galdan had reached Ejeitu; Habjir went to Ulerhui to await orders.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year scouts reported Galdan at Ejeitu and Habjir marched to Ulerhui awaiting orders.

sentences.zh: 是年，上親征噶爾丹還，賜坐塘諸弁兵銀。

translations.literal: That year, when the emperor returned from personally campaigning against Galdan, silver was granted to the relay-station officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: That year, on the emperor's return from his personal campaign against Galdan, silver was granted to the relay-station officers and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 五十五年，選兵隨大軍防禦策妄阿喇布坦。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fifth year, selected troops followed the great army in defending against Tsewang Rabtan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fifth year picked troops joined the main force against Tsewang Rabtan.

sentences.zh: 雍正九年，議剿噶爾丹策淩，詔徵烏珠穆沁西各扎薩克兵三千駐烏喇特汛防四十九旗遊牧，復諭烏珠穆沁別以兵駐克嚕倫河。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Yongzheng, when the suppression of Galdan Tsewang was deliberated, an edict requisitioned three thousand troops from the western jasaks of Ujumqin to garrison the Urad posts and protect the pastures of the forty-nine banners, and further instructed Ujumqin separately to station troops at the Kerulen River.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 9, when a campaign against Galdan Tsewang was planned, three thousand troops from Ujumqin's western jasaks were requisitioned to garrison the Urad line and protect the forty-nine banners' pastures, and Ujumqin was separately ordered to post troops on the Kerulen River.

sentences.zh: 十年，移駐達哩剛愛。

translations.literal: In the tenth year they were moved to garrison Daligangai.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year the garrison was shifted to Daligangai.

sentences.zh: 十三年，撤還。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year they were withdrawn and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year they were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十二年，詔嘉兩翼扎薩克，值所屬災，贍貧戶二萬餘，王貝勒以下各賜俸半年，無俸台吉俱賜幣有差。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Qianlong, an edict commended the jasaks of both wings. Because their subjects had suffered disaster, more than twenty thousand poor households were supported; princes and beiles and those below were each granted half a year's stipend, and taijis without stipends were all granted coin in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 12 both wing jasaks were commended. More than twenty thousand poor households were supported after disaster struck the banner; princes and beiles received half a year's stipend, and stipend-less taijis received coin in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 所部二旗：右翼駐巴克蘇爾哈臺山，左翼駐魁蘇陀羅海，與浩齊特、蘇尼特、阿巴噶、阿巴哈納爾諸部統盟於錫林郭勒。

translations.literal: The tribe had two banners: the right wing was stationed at Bak Sir Khatai Mountain, the left wing at Kuisu Toronhai; together with Haoqite, Sunid, Abaga, Abahanar, and other tribes it was united in the Xilin Gol League.
translations.idiomatic: The banner comprised two divisions: the right wing at Bak Sir Khatai Mountain and the left at Kuisu Toronhai. Together with Haoqite, Sunid, Abaga, Abahanar, and others it formed the Xilin Gol League.

sentences.zh: 爵四：扎薩克和碩車臣親王一，附鎮國公一，輔國公一，扎薩克多羅額爾德尼貝勒一。

translations.literal: There were four ranks: one jasak hoshu Setsen prince, one attached defender-of-the-state duke, one auxiliary state duke, and one jasak duoluo Erdeni beile.
translations.idiomatic: Four noble ranks were held: jasak hoshu Setsen prince, an attached defender-of-the-state duke, an auxiliary state duke, and jasak duoluo Erdeni beile.

sentences.zh: 左旗扎薩克貝勒色楞傳至達克丹都克雅紮布。

translations.literal: The left banner's jasak beile Seleng descended to Dakdan Dukyajab.
translations.idiomatic: The left banner's jasak beile Seleng was succeeded by Dakdan Dukyajab.

sentences.zh: 咸豐十年，以報效軍需駝馬，予郡王銜。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Xianfeng, for contributing transport camels and horses for military supplies, the rank of junwang was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 10 he was granted junwang rank for supplying transport camels and horses for the army.

sentences.zh: 是部左翼有固爾班泊，產鹽，由巴林橋烏丹城運售內地，西出圍場，分銷承德、豐、灤各屬；

translations.literal: The left wing of this tribe had Gurban Bo, which produced salt. It was transported for sale to the interior by way of Baarin Bridge and Wudan city; going west out of the imperial hunting grounds it was distributed in the jurisdictions of Chengde, Feng, and Luan;
translations.idiomatic: The banner's left wing had Gurban Bo, a salt-producing lake. Salt was shipped inland via Baarin Bridge and Wudan city; west of the imperial hunting grounds it was sold throughout Chengde, Feng, and Luan;

sentences.zh: 東出建平，分銷建昌、朝陽各屬；

translations.literal: going east out of Jianping it was distributed in the jurisdictions of Jianchang and Chaoyang;
translations.idiomatic: east of Jianping it reached the districts of Jianchang and Chaoyang;

sentences.zh: 遠者更可銷至奉天突泉諸縣，西南可由多倫至山西豐鎮、甯遠諸廳。

translations.literal: in the far distance it could even be sold as far as the counties of Tuquan in Fengtian; to the southwest it could go from Duolun to the offices of Fengzhen and Ningyuan in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: in the far northeast it reached as far as Tuquan in Fengtian, and to the southwest it was routed from Duolun to Fengzhen and Ningyuan in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十二年，都統廷傑奏定試辦蒙鹽章程。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year of Guangxu, Governor-General Ting Jie memorialized to fix regulations for a trial operation of Mongol salt.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 32 Governor-General Ting Jie memorialized regulations for a trial operation of Mongol salt.

sentences.zh: 宣統二年，度支部尚書載澤奏定山西蒙鹽辦法，謂東路以烏珠穆沁蒙鹽為主，以蘇尼特部鹽附之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuantong, Board of Revenue Minister Zaize memorialized to fix methods for Shanxi Mongol salt, stating that on the eastern route Ujumqin Mongol salt would be primary and Sunid salt attached to it.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 2 Board of Revenue Minister Zaize memorialized regulations for Shanxi Mongol salt, making Ujumqin salt primary on the eastern route with Sunid salt as a supplement.

sentences.zh: 左翼有佐領二十一，右翼有佐領九。

translations.literal: The left wing had twenty-one zuolings; the right wing had nine.
translations.idiomatic: The left wing had twenty-one zuolings and the right nine.

sentences.zh: 浩齊特部，在獨石口外，至京師千八百一十五里。

translations.literal: The Haoqite tribe is beyond Dushikou, one thousand eight hundred fifteen li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Haoqite banner lay beyond Dushikou, 1,815 li from the capital.

sentences.zh: 東西距百七十里，南北距三百七十五里。

translations.literal: East to west it measures one hundred seventy li; north to south three hundred seventy-five li.
translations.idiomatic: It measured 170 li from east to west and 375 li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 東及北烏珠穆沁，西阿巴噶，南克什克騰。

translations.literal: To the east and north is Ujumqin; to the west Abaga; to the south Hexigten.
translations.idiomatic: Ujumqin lay to the east and north, Abaga to the west, and Hexigten to the south.

sentences.zh: 元太祖十六世孫圖嚕博羅特，再傳至庫登汗，號其部曰浩齊特。

translations.literal: Tülu Bolot, sixteenth-generation descendant of the Yuan founding emperor, passed down two generations to Kuden Khan, who styled his tribe Haoqite.
translations.idiomatic: Tülu Bolot, sixteenth-generation scion of Genghis Khan, was succeeded two generations later by Kuden Khan, who styled his people Haoqite.

sentences.zh: 庫登汗孫德格類，號額爾德尼琿台吉。

translations.literal: Kuden Khan's grandson Degerlei was styled Erdeni Hwang Taiji.
translations.idiomatic: Kuden Khan's grandson Degerlei took the style Erdeni Hwang Taiji.

sentences.zh: 子五：長奇塔特紮幹杜棱土謝圖，次巴斯琫土謝圖，次策淩伊勒登土謝圖，次奇塔特昆杜棱額爾德尼車臣楚琥爾，次茂海墨爾根。

translations.literal: He had five sons: the elder Chitai Jahan Dulen Tüshe Tu; the second Basibung Tüshe Tu; the third Tsewang Ildeng Tüshe Tu; the fourth Chitai Gundulen Erdeni Setsen Choghor; the fifth Mohai Morgen.
translations.idiomatic: He had five sons: Chitai Jahan Dulen Tüshe Tu, the eldest; Basibung Tüshe Tu, second; Tsewang Ildeng Tüshe Tu, third; Chitai Gundulen Erdeni Setsen Choghor, fourth; and Mohai Morgen, fifth.

sentences.zh: 與察哈爾同族，為所屬。

translations.literal: They were of the same clan as Chakhar and subject to it.
translations.idiomatic: They belonged to the same clan as Chakhar and were subject to it.

sentences.zh: 以林丹汗不道，徙牧瀚海北，依喀爾喀。

translations.literal: Because Ligdan Khan was unjust, they moved to pasture north of the desert sea and depended on Khalkha.
translations.idiomatic: When Ligdan Khan proved tyrannical, they moved north of the Gobi to graze under Khalkha protection.

sentences.zh: 天聰八年，所部台吉額琳臣及塔布囊巴特瑪班第圖嚕齊、宰桑僧格布延徹臣烏巴什等，攜戶口駝馬自喀爾喀內附，遣使迎宴，賚甲胄、雕鞍、蟒服、銀幣。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tiancong, the tribe's taiji Elinjen and tabunang Batma Bandi Tüluqi, zaisang Senge Buyenchisen Ubasi, and others, bringing households, camels, and horses, submitted from Khalkha. Envoys were sent to welcome them with a banquet and grant armor, carved saddles, python robes, and silver coin.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 8 the banner's taiji Elinjen, tabunang Batma Bandi Tüluqi, zaisang Senge Buyenchisen Ubasi, and others submitted from Khalkha with their households, camels, and horses. The court sent envoys to welcome them with a feast and rewarded them with armor, carved saddles, python robes, and silver.

sentences.zh: 額琳臣屬有先附者五十三戶，仍命轄之。

translations.literal: Among Elinjen's subjects fifty-three households had submitted earlier and were still ordered under his jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: Fifty-three households of Elinjen's people who had submitted earlier remained under his jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 九年，大軍收服察哈爾，策淩伊勒登土謝圖偕烏珠穆沁諸部長表貢方物。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, after the great army subdued Chakhar, Tsewang Ildeng Tüshe Tu together with the chiefs of Ujumqin and other tribes presented tribute goods in memorial.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, after the Qing subdued Chakhar, Tsewang Ildeng Tüshe Tu joined the chiefs of Ujumqin and other tribes in presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，巴斯琫土謝圖偕蘇尼特部來貢。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde, Basibung Tüshe Tu together with the Sunid tribe came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1 Basibung Tüshe Tu and the Sunid banner came to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 二年，奇塔特昆杜棱額爾德尼車臣楚琥爾子博羅特率屬來歸。

translations.literal: In the second year, Bolot, son of Chitai Gundulen Erdeni Setsen Choghor, led his subjects to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Bolot, son of Chitai Gundulen Erdeni Setsen Choghor, led his people in submission.

sentences.zh: 順治三年，詔授扎薩克多羅額爾德尼貝勒，後晉封郡王。

translations.literal: In the third year of Shunzhi, an edict appointed him jasak duoluo Erdeni beile; later he was promoted to junwang.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 3 he was appointed jasak duoluo Erdeni beile and later promoted to junwang.

sentences.zh: 八年，奇塔特紮幹杜棱土謝圖子噶爾瑪色旺攜眾至。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Garmal Sewang, son of Chitai Jahan Dulen Tüshe Tu, arrived with his followers.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Garmal Sewang, son of Chitai Jahan Dulen Tüshe Tu, arrived with his followers.

sentences.zh: 十年，詔授扎薩克多羅郡王，以博羅特掌左翼，噶爾瑪色旺掌右翼。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, an edict appointed jasak duoluo junwang; Bolot was put in charge of the left wing and Garmal Sewang of the right wing.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year both were appointed jasak duoluo junwang; Bolot headed the left wing and Garmal Sewang the right.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十七年，詔發拜察儲粟賑其部貧戶，復命給銀。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year of Kangxi, an edict ordered grain from Baicha stores distributed to relieve poor households of the tribe, and silver was also granted.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 27 grain from Baicha stores was issued to relieve the banner's poor, and silver was granted as well.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，噶爾丹侵喀爾喀，詔兩翼扎薩克選兵駐界偵禦之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year, Galdan invaded Khalkha; an edict ordered the jasaks of both wings to select troops to garrison the border and scout against him.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year Galdan invaded Khalkha and both wing jasaks were ordered to post picked troops on the border to scout and defend against him.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，上親征噶爾丹，牧馬郭和蘇台，諭偕蘇尼特、阿巴哈納爾部長董牧務。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year the emperor personally campaigned against Galdan, pasturing horses at Gohosutai, and instructed the chiefs of Sunid and Abahanar jointly to oversee pasture duties.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 35 the emperor campaigned against Galdan in person, pasturing horses at Gohosutai, and ordered the Sunid and Abahanar chiefs jointly to oversee pasture duties.

sentences.zh: 凱旋，兩翼扎薩克率台吉等歡迎道左，諭獎飼秣得宜，並優賚監牧及修道鑿井諸弁兵。

translations.literal: On the victorious return, the jasaks of both wings led taijis and others to welcome him on the left of the road. They were commended for properly provisioning fodder, and the pasture supervisors and the officers and soldiers who repaired roads and dug wells were richly rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On the victorious return both wing jasaks led their taijis to welcome the emperor by the roadside. They were commended for properly provisioning fodder, and the pasture supervisors and the officers and soldiers who repaired roads and dug wells were richly rewarded.

sentences.zh: 五十四年，所部歉收，以唐三營儲粟賑之，並遣官往教之漁。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year the tribe had a poor harvest; grain from Tang Sanying stores was distributed for relief, and officials were also dispatched to teach them fishing.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fourth year a poor harvest prompted relief from Tang Sanying stores, and officials were sent to teach the people fishing.

sentences.zh: 雍正九年，大軍剿噶爾丹策淩，詔選兵分駐克嚕倫河。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Yongzheng, when the great army suppressed Galdan Tsewang, an edict ordered selected troops posted separately along the Kerulen River.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 9, during the campaign against Galdan Tsewang, picked troops were ordered posted along the Kerulen River.

sentences.zh: 十年，移駐達哩剛愛。

translations.literal: In the tenth year they were moved to garrison Daligangai.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year the garrison was shifted to Daligangai.

sentences.zh: 十三年，撤還。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year they were withdrawn and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year they were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 所部二旗：左翼駐特古哩克呼都克瑚欽，右翼駐烏默赫塞哩，隸錫林郭勒盟。

translations.literal: The tribe had two banners: the left wing was stationed at Tegürük Hodok Hoqin, the right wing at Umehkeri; it was subordinate to the Xilin Gol League.
translations.idiomatic: The banner comprised two divisions: the left wing at Tegürük Hodok Hoqin and the right at Umehkeri, both under the Xilin Gol League.

sentences.zh: 爵二：扎薩克多羅額爾德尼郡王一，扎薩克多羅郡王一。

translations.literal: There were two ranks: one jasak duoluo Erdeni junwang and one jasak duoluo junwang.
translations.idiomatic: Two noble ranks were held: jasak duoluo Erdeni junwang and jasak duoluo junwang.

sentences.zh: 是部左右翼有佐領各五。

translations.literal: The left and right wings of this tribe each had five zuolings.
translations.idiomatic: Each wing of the banner had five zuolings.

sentences.zh: 蘇尼特部，在張家口外，至京師九百六十里。

translations.literal: The Sunid tribe is beyond Zhangjiakou, nine hundred sixty li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Sunid banner lay beyond Zhangjiakou, 960 li from the capital.

sentences.zh: 東西距四百六里，南北距五百八十里。

translations.literal: East to west it measures four hundred six li; north to south five hundred eighty li.
translations.idiomatic: It measured 406 li from east to west and 580 li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 東阿巴噶，西四子部落，南察哈爾正藍旗牧廠，北瀚海。

translations.literal: To the east is Abaga; to the west the Fourth Tribe; to the south the Chakhar Plain Blue Banner pasture; to the north the desert sea.
translations.idiomatic: Abaga lay to the east, the Fourth Tribe to the west, the Chakhar Plain Blue Banner pasture to the south, and the Gobi to the north.

sentences.zh: 元太祖十六世孫圖嚕博羅特，再傳至庫克齊圖墨爾根台吉，號其部曰蘇尼特。

translations.literal: Tülu Bolot, sixteenth-generation descendant of the Yuan founding emperor, passed down two generations to Kukchi Morgen Taiji, who styled his tribe Sunid.
translations.idiomatic: Tülu Bolot, sixteenth-generation scion of Genghis Khan, was succeeded two generations later by Kukchi Morgen Taiji, who styled his people Sunid.

sentences.zh: 庫克齊圖墨爾根台吉子四：長布延琿台吉，子綽爾袞，居蘇尼特西路；

translations.literal: Kukchi Morgen Taiji had four sons: the elder Buyan Hwang Taiji, whose son was Chuo'er Gun, dwelt on the Sunid western route;
translations.idiomatic: Kukchi Morgen Taiji had four sons. The eldest, Buyan Hwang Taiji, was succeeded by his son Chuo'er Gun on the Sunid western route;

sentences.zh: 次布林海楚琥爾，子塔巴海達爾漢和碩齊，居蘇尼特東路。

translations.literal: the second Bulinhai Choghor, whose son was Tabakhai Darhan Hoshu Qi, dwelt on the Sunid eastern route.
translations.idiomatic: the second, Bulinhai Choghor, was succeeded by his son Tabakhai Darhan Hoshu Qi on the Sunid eastern route.

sentences.zh: 初皆服屬於察哈爾。

translations.literal: At first all were subject to Chakhar.
translations.idiomatic: Initially all were subject to Chakhar.

sentences.zh: 以林丹汗不道，徙牧瀚海北，依喀爾喀。

translations.literal: Because Ligdan Khan was unjust, they moved to pasture north of the desert sea and depended on Khalkha.
translations.idiomatic: When Ligdan Khan proved tyrannical, they moved north of the Gobi to graze under Khalkha protection.

sentences.zh: 天聰九年，綽爾袞子叟塞偕喀爾喀車臣汗碩壘遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Tiancong, Suusai, son of Chuo'er Gun, together with Khalkha Setsen Khan Shulei, dispatched envoys to offer tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 9 Suusai, son of Chuo'er Gun, joined Khalkha Setsen Khan Shulei in sending tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 崇德二年，塔巴海達爾漢和碩齊子騰機思、騰機特、莽古岱、哈爾呼喇偕台吉、偉徵等，各遣使來朝，賜朝鮮貢物。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chongde, Tenggis, Tengget, Mangudai, Harhula, sons of Tabakhai Darhan Hoshu Qi, together with taijis, weizheng, and others, each dispatched envoys to court and were granted Korean tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 2 Tenggis, Tengget, Mangudai, and Harhula, sons of Tabakhai Darhan Hoshu Qi, together with taijis, weizheng, and others, each sent envoys to court and received Korean tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 三年，台吉務善伊勒登、多爾濟喀喇巴圖魯、色棱、達爾瑪等從征喀爾喀扎薩克圖汗，偵遁，仍還。

translations.literal: In the third year, taijis Usan Ildeng, Dorji Karabatur, Seleng, Darma, and others followed the campaign against Khalkha Jasaktu Khan; he fled on reconnaissance and they returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year taijis Usan Ildeng, Dorji Karabatur, Seleng, Darma, and others joined the campaign against Khalkha Jasaktu Khan; when he fled during reconnaissance they withdrew.

sentences.zh: 四年春，台吉超察海、噶爾楚、瑭古特、卓特巴、什達喇、莽古思、鄂爾齋、巴圖賴、額思赫爾、僧格等來朝，賚冠服、甲胄、弓矢。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year, taijis Chochahai, Gartu, Tangud, Jotba, Shidala, Mangusi, Orjai, Baturai, Esher, Senge, and others came to court and were granted caps and robes, armor, bows and arrows.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year taijis Chochahai, Gartu, Tangud, Jotba, Shidala, Mangusi, Orjai, Baturai, Esher, Senge, and others came to court and received caps and robes, armor, and bows and arrows.

sentences.zh: 冬，騰機思、叟塞各率屬自喀爾喀來歸，入覲，獻駝馬。

translations.literal: In winter, Tenggis and Suusai each led their subjects to submit from Khalkha, entered audience, and presented camels and horses.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Tenggis and Suusai each led their people in submission from Khalkha, had audience at court, and presented camels and horses.

sentences.zh: 五年正月，賜叟塞、騰機思、騰機特、莽古岱、哈爾呼喇及台吉布達什希布、阿玉什、噶爾瑪色棱、額爾克、辰寶、茂海、伊勒畢斯等甲胄、銀幣。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year, Suusai, Tenggis, Tengget, Mangudai, Harhula, and taijis Budashihibu, Ayushi, Garmal Seleng, Erke, Chenbao, Mohai, Ilebes, and others were granted armor and silver coin.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifth year Suusai, Tenggis, Tengget, Mangudai, Harhula, and taijis Budashihibu, Ayushi, Garmal Seleng, Erke, Chenbao, Mohai, Ilebes, and others received armor and silver.

sentences.zh: 十月，台吉烏班岱、棟果爾、鄂爾齊、博希、沙津等來貢馬，賚冠服、鞍轡。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, taijis Ubendai, Donggo'er, Orji, Bohi, Shajin, and others came to offer horses and were granted caps and robes and saddlery.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month taijis Ubendai, Donggo'er, Orji, Bohi, Shajin, and others presented horses at court and received caps, robes, and saddlery.

sentences.zh: 六年，授騰機思扎薩克多羅郡王。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Tenggis was appointed jasak duoluo junwang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Tenggis was appointed jasak duoluo junwang.

sentences.zh: 七年，授叟塞扎薩克多羅杜棱郡王。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Suusai was appointed jasak duoluo Dulen junwang.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Suusai was appointed jasak duoluo Dulen junwang.

sentences.zh: 以騰機思掌左翼，叟塞掌右翼。

translations.literal: Tenggis was put in charge of the left wing and Suusai of the right wing.
translations.idiomatic: Tenggis was placed at the head of the left wing and Suusai at the head of the right.

sentences.zh: 順治三年，騰機思以車臣汗碩壘誘叛，率弟騰機特及台吉烏班岱、多爾濟斯喀等逃喀爾喀。

translations.literal: In the third year of Shunzhi, Tenggis, incited to rebel by Setsen Khan Shulei, fled to Khalkha with his younger brother Tengget and taijis Ubendai, Dorjisika, and others.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 3 Tenggis, incited to rebel by Setsen Khan Shulei, fled to Khalkha with his brother Tengget and taijis Ubendai, Dorjisika, and others.

sentences.zh: 上遣師偕外籓軍由克嚕倫追剿至諤特克山及圖拉河，騰機思、騰機特遁，獲其孥。

translations.literal: The emperor dispatched troops together with outer dependency armies to pursue and suppress them from the Kerulen to Etek Mountain and the Tula River. Tenggis and Tengget escaped, but their wives and children were captured.
translations.idiomatic: The court sent troops with outer-dependency forces in pursuit from the Kerulen to Etek Mountain and the Tula River. Tenggis and Tengget escaped, but their families were captured.

sentences.zh: 烏班岱、多爾濟斯喀為四子部落軍陣斬。

translations.literal: Ubendai and Dorjisika were slain in battle by the Fourth Tribe army.
translations.idiomatic: Ubendai and Dorjisika were killed in battle by Fourth Tribe troops.

sentences.zh: 師旋，以烏班岱從子讬濟弗從叛，且隨剿，賜所俘。

translations.literal: When the army returned, because Ubendai's nephew Tojifu had joined the rebellion yet also followed in the suppression, he was granted the captives.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return, Ubendai's nephew Tojifu, who had joined the rebellion but also took part in the suppression, was granted the captives.

sentences.zh: 五年，騰機思及騰機特悔罪乞降，詔宥死，仍襲爵如初。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Tenggis and Tengget repented their crimes and begged to surrender; an edict spared them from death and restored their inherited ranks as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Tenggis and Tengget repented and surrendered; the court spared their lives and restored their inherited ranks.

sentences.zh: 康熙十年，所部歉收，詔發宣化府及歸化城賑粟儲之，復酌給馬牛羊。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Kangxi, the tribe had a poor harvest; an edict ordered relief grain issued from Xuanhua Prefecture and Guihua City stores, and horses, cattle, and sheep were also granted in measured amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 10 a poor harvest prompted relief grain from Xuanhua Prefecture and Guihua City stores, and horses, cattle, and sheep were also granted in measured amounts.

sentences.zh: 二十年，遣官察給兩翼災戶銀米。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, officials were dispatched to investigate and grant silver and grain to disaster-affected households of both wings.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year officials were sent to assess and grant silver and grain to disaster-affected households in both wings.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，噶爾丹侵喀爾喀，詔選兵二千防汛。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, Galdan invaded Khalkha; an edict ordered two thousand selected troops posted for flood-season defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year Galdan invaded Khalkha and two thousand picked troops were ordered posted on border defense.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，噶爾丹襲喀爾喀昆都倫博碩克圖袞布，詔新部王以下原效力者，赴軍聽用。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, Galdan attacked Khalkha Kundelen Boshoktu Gunbu; an edict ordered those below the new-tribe princes who had originally served to go to the army and await employment.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year Galdan attacked Khalkha Kundelen Boshoktu Gunbu, and nobles below the new-tribe princes who had previously served were ordered to join the army.

sentences.zh: 尋噶爾丹入烏珠穆沁界，諭還駐本旗要汛。

translations.literal: Soon Galdan entered Ujumqin territory; they were instructed to return and garrison the key posts of their own banner.
translations.idiomatic: When Galdan entered Ujumqin territory they were ordered back to garrison their banner's key posts.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，上親征噶爾丹，詔選兵赴烏勒輝聽調，以牧馬郭和蘇台，偕浩齊特、阿巴噶、阿巴哈納爾諸部長董牧務。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year the emperor personally campaigned against Galdan; an edict ordered selected troops sent to Ulerhui to await orders, pasturing horses at Gohosutai, and jointly overseeing pasture duties with the chiefs of Haoqite, Abaga, Abahanar, and other tribes.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 35 the emperor campaigned against Galdan in person; picked troops were sent to Ulerhui awaiting orders, pasturing horses at Gohosutai while jointly overseeing pasture duties with the chiefs of Haoqite, Abaga, Abahanar, and others.

sentences.zh: 凱旋，諭★飼牧得宜，並優賚監牧及修道鑿井諸弁兵。

translations.literal: On the victorious return, they were commended for properly provisioning pasture, and the pasture supervisors and the officers and soldiers who repaired roads and dug wells were richly rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On the victorious return they were commended for properly managing pasture, and the pasture supervisors and the officers and soldiers who repaired roads and dug wells were richly rewarded.

sentences.zh: 以右翼扎薩克屬旺舒克、左翼扎薩克屬博羅紮布鄉導功，賜號達爾漢。

translations.literal: Because the right-wing jasak's subordinate Wangshuk and the left-wing jasak's subordinate Borojab had guided merit, they were granted the designation Darhan.
translations.idiomatic: The right-wing jasak's subordinate Wangshuk and the left-wing jasak's subordinate Borojab were granted the title Darhan for their service as guides.

sentences.zh: 復詔郡王薩穆紮之第三子多爾濟思喀布貝勒、博木布之長子素岱會師圖拉河，緝噶爾丹。

translations.literal: An edict further ordered Prince Samja's third son Dorjisikab beile and Bomub's eldest son Sudai to join forces at the Tula River to apprehend Galdan.
translations.idiomatic: The court further ordered Prince Samja's third son Dorjisikab beile and Bomub's eldest son Sudai to join forces on the Tula River to apprehend Galdan.

sentences.zh: 尋分右翼兵赴珠勒輝克爾阿濟爾罕、左翼兵赴伊察紮罕，以不見賊蹤，撤還。

translations.literal: Soon the right-wing troops were sent to Jülehui Ker Ajirhan and the left-wing troops to Ichajahan; because no trace of the enemy was found, they were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: Right-wing troops were then sent to Jülehui Ker Ajirhan and left-wing troops to Ichajahan; finding no enemy trace, both forces withdrew.

sentences.zh: 五十四年，災，詔發張家口儲粟並帑十萬，自台吉下六萬四千九百餘丁遍贍之。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year, during disaster, an edict ordered grain from Zhangjiakou stores and one hundred thousand taels from the treasury distributed; from taiji downward, more than sixty-four thousand nine hundred ding were all supported.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fourth year disaster prompted relief from Zhangjiakou stores and one hundred thousand taels from the treasury; more than 64,900 registered men from taiji downward were all supported.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，右翼二等台吉進達克以追捕叛賊遇害，晉贈一等台吉，命視公爵致祭。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng, the right-wing second-class taiji Jindak was killed while pursuing rebel bandits; he was posthumously promoted to first-class taiji, and sacrifices were ordered as for a duke.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 the right-wing second-class taiji Jindak was killed pursuing rebels; he was posthumously promoted to first-class taiji and granted ducal funeral rites.

sentences.zh: 子三：長噶爾瑪遜多布，封輔國公；

translations.literal: He had three sons: the elder Garmal Sundob, enfeoffed auxiliary state duke;
translations.idiomatic: He had three sons. The eldest, Garmal Sundob, was enfeoffed auxiliary state duke;

sentences.zh: 次噶爾瑪策布騰；

translations.literal: the second Garmal Tsebuteng;
translations.idiomatic: the second, Garmal Tsebuteng;

sentences.zh: 次恭格垂穆丕勒。

translations.literal: the third Gongge Cuimubile.
translations.idiomatic: the third, Gongge Cuimubile.

sentences.zh: 以隨捕賊功，各晉台吉秩有差。

translations.literal: For merit in following the pursuit of bandits, each was promoted in taiji rank by varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: For their service in the pursuit each was promoted in taiji rank by varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 噶爾瑪遜多布爵後停襲。

translations.literal: Garmal Sundob's rank was later discontinued in inheritance.
translations.idiomatic: Garmal Sundob's rank was later discontinued in succession.

sentences.zh: 二年，所部災，賜銀賑之。

translations.literal: In the second year the tribe suffered disaster and silver was granted for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year disaster struck the banner and silver was granted for relief.

sentences.zh: 九年，調兵屯克嚕倫河，防禦噶爾丹策淩。

translations.literal: In the ninth year troops were transferred to garrison the Kerulen River to defend against Galdan Tsewang.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year troops were posted on the Kerulen River against Galdan Tsewang.

sentences.zh: 十年，有奏商都達布遜諾爾牧廠應移蘇尼特汛者，上飭止之，令各居其牧。

translations.literal: In the tenth year there was a memorial that the Shangdu Dabsonnor pasture should be moved to the Sunid posts; the emperor ordered this stopped and commanded each to remain on its own pasture.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year a memorial proposed moving the Shangdu Dabsonnor pasture to the Sunid line; the emperor rejected it and ordered each group to remain on its own pasture.

sentences.zh: 十二年，所部兵駐防達哩剛愛。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year the tribe's troops garrisoned Daligangai.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year the banner's troops garrisoned Daligangai.

sentences.zh: 十三年，撤還。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year they were withdrawn and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year they were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十二年，以災告饑，遣官往賑。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Qianlong, because disaster was reported and there was famine, officials were dispatched for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 12 famine was reported after disaster and officials were sent to provide relief.

sentences.zh: 所部二旗：左翼駐和林圖察伯台岡，右翼駐薩敏西勒山，隸錫林郭勒盟。

translations.literal: The tribe had two banners: the left wing was stationed at Kherlen Tuchabtai Gang, the right wing at Samin Xile Mountain; it was subordinate to the Xilin Gol League.
translations.idiomatic: The banner comprised two divisions: the left wing at Kherlen Tuchabtai Gang and the right at Samin Xile Mountain, both under the Xilin Gol League.

sentences.zh: 爵四：扎薩克多羅郡王一；

translations.literal: There were four ranks: one jasak duoluo junwang;
translations.idiomatic: Four noble ranks were held: one jasak duoluo junwang;

sentences.zh: 附多羅貝勒一；

translations.literal: one attached duoluo beile;
translations.idiomatic: one attached duoluo beile;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克多羅杜棱郡王一；

translations.literal: one jasak duoluo Dulen junwang;
translations.idiomatic: one jasak duoluo Dulen junwang;

sentences.zh: 附輔國公一，由貝勒降襲。

translations.literal: one attached auxiliary state duke, inherited by descent from beile.
translations.idiomatic: one attached auxiliary state duke, inherited by descent from beile rank.

sentences.zh: 洎五十六年，以是部連年被旱，又特賑之。

translations.literal: By the fifty-sixth year, because this tribe had suffered drought for successive years, special relief was again granted.
translations.idiomatic: By the fifty-sixth year successive droughts had afflicted the banner and special relief was granted again.

sentences.zh: 道光十三年，右翼郡王與喀爾喀親王爭界，詔察哈爾都統凱音布往勘。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Daoguang, the right-wing junwang disputed boundaries with a Khalkha prince; an edict ordered Chakhar governor-general Kai Yinbu to go and survey.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 13 the right-wing junwang disputed boundaries with a Khalkha prince, and Chakhar governor-general Kai Yinbu was ordered to survey the border.

sentences.zh: 尋以喀爾喀災，緩之。

translations.literal: Soon because of Khalkha disaster, this was deferred.
translations.idiomatic: The survey was soon deferred because of disaster in Khalkha.

sentences.zh: 其地當漠南北之沖，歷代由漠南用兵漠北者，多出其途。

translations.literal: Its territory stood at the crossroads between south and north of the desert; through the ages those who used the southern desert to campaign into the northern desert mostly went by this route.
translations.idiomatic: Its territory stood at the crossroads between Inner and Outer Mongolia; through the ages armies moving from the southern steppe into the northern desert mostly passed this way.

sentences.zh: 光緒末，于蘇尼特右翼王府東北七十里置電報局，曰滂江，以通烏得叨林之電。

translations.literal: At the end of the Guangxu reign, a telegraph office called Pangjiang was established seventy li northeast of the Sunid right-wing princely residence to connect with the telegraph at Udetolin.
translations.idiomatic: Late in the Guangxu reign a telegraph office called Pangjiang was established seventy li northeast of the Sunid right-wing princely residence to connect with the line at Udetolin.

sentences.zh: 是部亦產鹽，西南行銷山西豐甯諸廳。

translations.literal: This tribe also produced salt, which was sold southwest into the offices of Feng and Ning in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: The banner also produced salt, shipped southwest for sale in the Feng and Ning districts of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 左翼有佐領二十，右翼有佐領十三。

translations.literal: The left wing had twenty zuolings; the right wing had thirteen zuolings.
translations.idiomatic: The left wing had twenty zuolings and the right thirteen.

sentences.zh: 阿巴噶部，在張家口外，至京師千里。

translations.literal: The Abaga tribe is beyond Zhangjiakou, one thousand li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Abaga banner lay beyond Zhangjiakou, 1,000 li from the capital.

sentences.zh: 東西距二百里，南北距二百有十里。

translations.literal: East to west it measures two hundred li; north to south two hundred and ten li.
translations.idiomatic: It measured 200 li from east to west and 210 li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 東阿巴哈納爾，西蘇尼特，南察哈爾正藍旗牧廠，北瀚海。

translations.literal: To the east is Abahanar; to the west Sunid; to the south the Chakhar Plain Blue Banner pasture; to the north the desert sea.
translations.idiomatic: Abahanar lay to the east, Sunid to the west, the Chakhar Plain Blue Banner pasture to the south, and the Gobi to the north.

sentences.zh: 元太祖弟布格博勒格圖，十七傳至巴雅思瑚布林古特。

translations.literal: The younger brother of the Yuan founding emperor, Buhe Bolot, passed down seventeen generations to Bayasihu Bolingut.
translations.idiomatic: Buhe Bolot, younger brother of Genghis Khan, was succeeded seventeen generations later by Bayasihu Bolingut.

sentences.zh: 子二，長塔爾尼庫同，號所部曰阿巴噶。

translations.literal: He had two sons; the elder Tarnikutong styled his tribe Abaga.
translations.idiomatic: He had two sons. The elder, Tarnikutong, styled his people Abaga.

sentences.zh: 塔爾尼庫同子二：長素僧克偉徵，子額爾德尼圖捫，號扎薩克圖諾顏；

translations.literal: Tarnikutong had two sons: the elder Susengk Weizheng, whose son Erdeni Tumun was styled Jasagtu Noyan;
translations.idiomatic: Tarnikutong had two sons. The elder, Susengk Weizheng, was succeeded by his son Erdeni Tumun, styled Jasagtu Noyan;

sentences.zh: 次揚古岱卓哩克圖，子多爾濟，號額齊格諾顏。

translations.literal: the second Yanggudai Joriktu, whose son Dorji was styled Ekeg Noyan.
translations.idiomatic: the second, Yanggudai Joriktu, was succeeded by his son Dorji, styled Ekeg Noyan.

sentences.zh: 初稱阿嚕蒙古，服屬於察哈爾。

translations.literal: At first they were called Aru Mongol and were subject to Chakhar.
translations.idiomatic: Initially styled Aru Mongol, they were subject to Chakhar.

sentences.zh: 以林丹汗不道，徙牧瀚海北克嚕倫河界，依喀爾喀車臣汗碩壘。

translations.literal: Because Ligdan Khan was unjust, they moved to pasture north of the desert sea on the Kerulen River border and depended on Khalkha Setsen Khan Shulei.
translations.idiomatic: When Ligdan Khan proved tyrannical, they moved north of the Gobi to the Kerulen borderlands under Khalkha Setsen Khan Shulei.

sentences.zh: 天聰二年，偕喀喇沁、土默特、鄂爾多斯諸部長擊察哈爾眾四萬於土默特之趙城，復約喀爾喀偕喀喇沁乞師問察哈爾罪。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tiancong, together with the chiefs of Kharchin, Tumed, and Ordos they struck forty thousand Chakhar troops at Zhaocheng in Tumed, and also arranged with Khalkha and Kharchin to request troops and inquire into Chakhar's crimes.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 2 they joined Kharchin, Tumed, and Ordos chiefs in defeating forty thousand Chakhar troops at Zhaocheng in Tumed, and also arranged with Khalkha and Kharchin to request troops and press Chakhar's crimes.

sentences.zh: 六年，台吉奇塔特楚琥爾攜眾五百內附。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, taiji Chitai Choghor brought five hundred followers to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year taiji Chitai Choghor submitted with five hundred followers.

sentences.zh: 九年，大軍收服察哈爾，額爾德尼圖捫孫都思噶爾等附車臣汗碩壘表貢方物。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, after the great army subdued Chakhar, Dusigar and others, descendants of Erdeni Tumun, together with Setsen Khan Shulei, presented tribute goods in memorial.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, after the Qing subdued Chakhar, Dusigar and other descendants of Erdeni Tumun joined Setsen Khan Shulei in presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 崇德四年，額齊格諾顏多爾濟自喀爾喀來歸。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Chongde, Ekeg Noyan Dorji submitted from Khalkha.
