translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 4 Ekeg Noyan Dorji submitted from Khalkha.

sentences.zh: 時有同名多爾濟者，號達爾漢諾顏，率眾皆至。

translations.literal: At the time there was another Dorji of the same name, styled Darhan Noyan, who also led his followers and all arrived.
translations.idiomatic: At the time another Dorji of the same name, styled Darhan Noyan, also arrived with his followers.

sentences.zh: 六年，詔授額齊格諾顏多爾濟為扎薩克多羅卓哩克圖郡王。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, an edict appointed Ekeg Noyan Dorji jasak duoluo Joriktu junwang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Ekeg Noyan Dorji was appointed jasak duoluo Joriktu junwang.

sentences.zh: 順治八年，都思噶爾自喀爾喀來歸，詔授扎薩克多羅郡王。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Shunzhi, Dusigar submitted from Khalkha; an edict appointed jasak duoluo junwang.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 8 Dusigar submitted from Khalkha and was appointed jasak duoluo junwang.

sentences.zh: 以多爾濟掌左翼，都思噶爾掌右翼，遣官定牧地。

translations.literal: Dorji was put in charge of the left wing and Dusigar of the right wing, and officials were dispatched to fix pasture lands.
translations.idiomatic: Dorji was placed at the head of the left wing and Dusigar at the head of the right, and officials were sent to demarcate pastures.

sentences.zh: 康熙六年，阿巴哈納爾部乞降，以阿巴噶牧地賜之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Kangxi, the Abahanar tribe begged to surrender, and Abaga pasture lands were granted to them.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 6 the Abahanar banner submitted, and Abaga pastures were granted to them.

sentences.zh: 遣官視浩齊特、蘇尼特界外水草豐美地，指給阿巴噶移牧。

translations.literal: Officials were dispatched to inspect lush pasture lands beyond the Haoqite and Sunid borders and assign them to Abaga for relocation.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were sent to survey fertile grazing lands beyond the Haoqite and Sunid borders and allotted them to Abaga for resettlement.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，噶爾丹侵喀爾喀，詔所部王以下原效力者，赴軍聽用。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, when Galdan invaded Khalkha, an edict ordered princes and others of the banner who had previously served to report to the army for assignment.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year, when Galdan invaded Khalkha, the court ordered princes and others who had served before to report to the army for duty.

sentences.zh: 復諭偕阿巴哈納爾供軍糈，兼防新降喀爾喀掠諸內扎薩克牧產。

translations.literal: They were further instructed to supply army provisions together with Abahanar and also guard against newly submitted Khalkha raiding the livestock of Inner Jasak banners.
translations.idiomatic: They were also told to supply provisions with Abahanar and guard against newly submitted Khalkha raiders preying on Inner Jasak herds.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，以台吉班第額爾德尼岱青、根敦、巴雅爾、納木塔爾、扎木素、齊達什等導烏梁海眾內附，均授二等台吉。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, for guiding the Uriankhai people to submit, taijis Bandi Erdeni Daqing, Günden, Bayar, Namtar, Jamusu, Qidaishi, and others were all granted second-class taiji rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year taijis Bandi Erdeni Daqing, Günden, Bayar, Namtar, Jamusu, and Qidaishi were all raised to second-class taiji for guiding the Uriankhai to submit.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，上親征噶爾丹，牧馬郭和蘇台，諭偕浩齊特、蘇尼特、阿巴哈納爾諸部長董牧務。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year the emperor personally campaigned against Galdan. Horses were pastured at Guohesu Tai, and the chiefs of Haoqite, Sunid, Abahanar, and other tribes were instructed jointly to oversee herding duties.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year the emperor marched against Galdan in person. With horses pastured at Guohesu Tai, the chiefs of Haoqite, Sunid, Abahanar, and allied banners were ordered to supervise the herds together.

sentences.zh: 凱旋，諭獎飼牧得宜，並優賚監牧及修道鑿井諸弁兵。

translations.literal: On triumphant return they were commended for properly provisioning fodder, and the officers and soldiers who supervised herding, built roads, and dug wells were generously rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On the victorious return they were praised for keeping the herds well supplied, and the officers and men who supervised grazing, built roads, and dug wells were richly rewarded.

sentences.zh: 復以所部達濟桑阿鄉導功，賜號達爾漢。

translations.literal: Dajisang'a of the banner was further granted the title Darhan for his service as guide.
translations.idiomatic: Dajisang'a of the banner was also granted the title Darhan for guiding the army.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，王、貝子、台吉等朝正，請備馬從軍，慰令各歸所部。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year princes, beizi, taijis, and others came for the New Year audience, requested to ready horses and follow the army, and were comforted and ordered each to return to his banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year princes, beizi, and taijis came for the New Year audience offering horses for campaign service; the emperor thanked them and sent each back to his banner.

sentences.zh: 時有二等台吉圖把紮布色臣楚琥爾者，年八十八，諭嘉其奮志報效，優賚之。

translations.literal: At that time there was a second-class taiji named Tubazhabu Sechen Chuhu'er, aged eighty-eight. The emperor commended his eager resolve to serve and rewarded him generously.
translations.idiomatic: Among them was second-class taiji Tubazhabu Sechen Chuhu'er, aged eighty-eight; the emperor praised his zeal to serve and rewarded him handsomely.

sentences.zh: 五十四年，以災歉收，詔發唐三營儲粟賑之，復賜無產台吉牧牲。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year, because disaster caused poor harvests, an edict ordered grain from the Tang Sanying storehouses distributed in relief, and livestock was again granted to taijis without property.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fourth year crop failure brought on by disaster prompted relief grain from the Tang Sanying storehouses, and destitute taijis were again given herds.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年，遣官齎銀賑所部貧戶。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongzheng, officials were dispatched bearing silver to relieve the poor households of the banner.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 2 officials were sent with silver to aid needy households under the banner.

sentences.zh: 九年，大軍剿噶爾丹策淩，徵兵駐達哩剛愛。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, when the main army suppressed Galdan Tseren, troops were mobilized and stationed at Daligangai.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year troops were mobilized and posted at Daligangai for the campaign against Galdan Tseren.

sentences.zh: 十三年，撤還。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year they were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year they were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十一年，旱災，賑之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Qianlong there was drought disaster, and relief was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 11 drought struck and the court granted relief.

sentences.zh: 五十四年，扎薩克卓里克圖郡王喇特納什第以事奪扎薩克，予其弟巴勒丹僧格一等台吉扎薩克。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year Jasak Jöliktu Prince Latenashidi was stripped of his jasak rank for misconduct, and his younger brother Baledan Sengge was granted first-class taiji jasak.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fourth year Jasak Jöliktu Prince Latenashidi lost his jasak rank for misconduct, and his brother Baledan Sengge was appointed first-class taiji jasak in his place.

sentences.zh: 所部二旗，左翼駐科布林塞哩，右翼駐巴顏額倫。

translations.literal: The tribe had two banners. The left wing was stationed at Kebulin Saili; the right wing at Bayan Elun.
translations.idiomatic: The banner had two divisions: the left wing at Kebulin Saili and the right at Bayan Elun.

sentences.zh: 爵五：扎薩克多羅郡王一；

translations.literal: There were five ranks: one jasak duoluo junwang;
translations.idiomatic: There were five noble ranks: one jasak prince of the first rank;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克一等台吉一；

translations.literal: one jasak first-class taiji;
translations.idiomatic: one jasak first-class taiji;

sentences.zh: 附多羅卓裏克圖郡王一；

translations.literal: one attached duoluo Jöliktu junwang;
translations.idiomatic: one attached Jöliktu prince of the first rank;

sentences.zh: 固山達爾漢貝子一；

translations.literal: one gushan Darhan beizi;
translations.idiomatic: one banner Darhan beizi;

sentences.zh: 輔國達爾漢公一，由貝子降襲。

translations.literal: one auxiliary state Darhan duke, who inherited after demotion from beizi rank.
translations.idiomatic: and one auxiliary state Darhan duke, who had inherited after demotion from beizi rank.

sentences.zh: 右翼扎薩克巴勒丹僧格三傳至杜噶爾布木。

translations.literal: Three generations after right-wing jasak Baledan Sengge came Dugar Bumu.
translations.idiomatic: The right-wing jasak line passed from Baledan Sengge through three generations to Dugar Bumu.

sentences.zh: 咸豐七年，以報效軍需，予鎮國公銜。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Xianfeng, for contributing military supplies, he was granted the designation of defender duke of the state.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 7 he was granted defender-duke rank for supplying the army.

sentences.zh: 是部左右翼有佐領各十一。

translations.literal: This tribe's left and right wings each had eleven zuolings.
translations.idiomatic: Each wing of the banner had eleven zuolings.

sentences.zh: 阿巴哈納爾部，在張家口外，至京師千五十里。

translations.literal: The Abahanar tribe is beyond Zhangjiakou, one thousand fifty li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Abahanar banner lay beyond Zhangjiakou, some 1,050 li from the capital.

sentences.zh: 東西距百八十里，南北距四百三十六里。

translations.literal: East to west it measures one hundred eighty li; north to south four hundred thirty-six li.
translations.idiomatic: It measured 180 li from east to west and 436 li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 東浩齊特，西阿巴噶，南察哈爾正藍旗牧廠，北瀚海。

translations.literal: To the east is Haoqite; to the west Abaga; to the south the Chakhar Plain Blue Banner pasture reserve; to the north the Gobi.
translations.idiomatic: Haoqite lay to the east, Abaga to the west, the Chakhar Plain Blue Banner pasture reserve to the south, and the Gobi to the north.

sentences.zh: 元太祖弟布格博勒格圖，十八傳至諾密特默克圖，號所部曰阿巴哈納爾。

translations.literal: Bugibolegetu, younger brother of the Yuan founding emperor, was succeeded eighteen generations later by Nomit Mögtu, who styled his tribe Abahanar.
translations.idiomatic: Bugibolegetu, younger brother of Genghis Khan, was succeeded eighteen generations later by Nomit Mögtu, who named his people Abahanar.

sentences.zh: 再傳至多爾濟伊勒登。

translations.literal: Two generations later came Dorji Ildeng.
translations.idiomatic: Two generations later came Dorji Ildeng.

sentences.zh: 子二：長色棱墨爾根，次棟伊思喇布。

translations.literal: He had two sons: the elder Seleng Morgen, the younger Dong Israb.
translations.idiomatic: He had two sons: the elder Seleng Morgen and the younger Dong Israb.

sentences.zh: 初稱阿嚕蒙古，依喀爾喀車臣汗碩壘。

translations.literal: At first they styled themselves Arlu Mongols and depended on Khalkha Sechen Khan Shulei.
translations.idiomatic: At first they called themselves Arlu Mongols and lived under Khalkha Sechen Khan Shulei.

sentences.zh: 駐牧克嚕倫河界，其地在瀚海北。

translations.literal: They grazed on the Kerulen River border; their lands lay north of the Gobi.
translations.idiomatic: They pastured on the Kerulen River frontier, north of the Gobi.

sentences.zh: 崇德七年，有和碩泰者，台吉達喇務巴三察屬也，攜孥內附。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Chongde there was one Hosho Tai, a follower of Taiji Darawu Basancha, who brought his family and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 7 Hosho Tai, a follower of Taiji Darawu Basancha, brought his family over to the Qing.

sentences.zh: 嗣托克托伊達嚕噶、達賴等至，皆優養之。

translations.literal: Later Toktoy Dalga, Dalai, and others arrived, and all were generously maintained.
translations.idiomatic: Later Toktoy Dalga, Dalai, and others arrived and were all generously provisioned.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年，台吉阿喇納、噶爾瑪，宰桑固英等越瀚海南牧綽諾陀羅海近內汛。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangxi, Taijis Alana and Garmal, jasang Guyin, and others crossed south of the Gobi to graze at Chuonuo Toronhai near the inner frontier post.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 1 taijis Alana and Garmal, jasang Guyin, and others crossed south of the Gobi to graze at Chuonuo Toronhai near the inner border post.

sentences.zh: 三年，色棱墨爾根復如之。

translations.literal: In the third year Seleng Morgen did the same.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Seleng Morgen did likewise.

sentences.zh: 守臣以聞，上知為喀爾喀所脅，宥罪遣歸。

translations.literal: Frontier officials reported this. The emperor knew they had been coerced by Khalkha, pardoned their offense, and sent them back.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier officials reported the incursion. Knowing they had been pressed by Khalkha, the emperor pardoned them and sent them home.

sentences.zh: 因諭喀爾喀以噶爾拜、瀚海為牧界，繼此有越者留勿遣。

translations.literal: Khalkha was therefore instructed to take Ga'erbai and the Gobi as pasture boundaries; hereafter those who crossed were to be detained and not sent back.
translations.idiomatic: Khalkha was told to keep Ga'erbai and the Gobi as the grazing boundary; anyone crossing thereafter was to be detained.

sentences.zh: 四年，喀爾喀復違諭，令阿巴哈納爾台吉牧瀚海南。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Khalkha again violated the instruction and ordered Abahanar taijis to graze south of the Gobi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Khalkha again defied the order and sent Abahanar taijis to graze south of the Gobi.

sentences.zh: 棟伊思喇布弗之從。

translations.literal: Dong Israb refused to obey.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Israb refused to comply.

sentences.zh: 尋偕台吉阿喇納、噶爾瑪等率眾來歸，詔授扎薩克固山貝子。

translations.literal: Soon afterward, together with Taijis Alana, Garmal, and others, he led his people to submit. An edict appointed him jasak gushan beizi.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he and taijis Alana, Garmal, and others brought their people over to the Qing, and he was appointed jasak banner beizi.

sentences.zh: 阿喇納、噶爾瑪以各攜丁七百餘，均授一等台吉。

translations.literal: Alana and Garmal, each bringing more than seven hundred men, were both granted first-class taiji.
translations.idiomatic: Alana and Garmal, each leading more than seven hundred men, were both granted first-class taiji rank.

sentences.zh: 五年，色棱墨爾根亦來歸。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Seleng Morgen also came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Seleng Morgen also submitted.

sentences.zh: 六年，詔授扎薩克多羅貝勒，遣官指示阿巴噶部移牧他所，以舊牧地給阿巴哈納爾。

translations.literal: In the sixth year an edict appointed him jasak duoluo beile. Officials were dispatched to instruct the Abaga tribe to move its pastures elsewhere and give the old grazing lands to Abahanar.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was appointed jasak duoluo beile. Officials ordered Abaga to relocate its herds and ceded the former pastures to Abahanar.

sentences.zh: 色棱墨爾根掌左翼，棟伊思喇布掌右翼。

translations.literal: Seleng Morgen led the left wing; Dong Israb led the right wing.
translations.idiomatic: Seleng Morgen headed the left wing and Dong Israb the right.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，噶爾丹侵喀爾喀，哲卜尊丹巴呼圖克圖奔赴內汛，所部班第岱青、車淩岱青奉詔督兵二百往護，復選兵千三百由瀚海偵噶爾丹。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year Galdan invaded Khalkha. The Jebzundamba Khutukhtu fled to the inner frontier post. Bandi Daqing and Cheleng Daqing of the banner were ordered by edict to lead two hundred troops to escort him, and one thousand three hundred troops were selected to scout for Galdan through the Gobi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, when Galdan invaded Khalkha, the Jebzundamba Khutukhtu fled to the inner border. Bandi Daqing and Cheleng Daqing were ordered to escort him with two hundred men, while thirteen hundred troops were sent through the Gobi to scout for Galdan.

sentences.zh: 先是色棱墨爾根、棟伊思喇布來歸，阿巴哈納爾諸台吉有留居喀爾喀者，至是隨哲卜尊丹巴呼圖克圖、額爾德尼台吉納木紮勒等至，曰根敦額爾克，曰阿海烏巴什，曰伊克岱青，曰額爾克烏巴什，挈屬戶千餘，詔納之。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Seleng Morgen and Dong Israb submitted, some Abahanar taijis had remained in Khalkha. At this time they arrived with the Jebzundamba Khutukhtu, Erdeni Taiji Namjale, and others — Günden Erke, Ahai Ubash, Ik Daqing, and Erke Ubash — bringing more than one thousand households, and an edict ordered them received.
translations.idiomatic: When Seleng Morgen and Dong Israb had first submitted, some Abahanar taijis had stayed behind in Khalkha. Now they arrived with the Jebzundamba Khutukhtu and Erdeni Taiji Namjale — Günden Erke, Ahai Ubash, Ik Daqing, and Erke Ubash among them — bringing more than a thousand households, and the court ordered them received.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，噶爾丹復侵喀爾喀，至烏勒劄河，所部選兵四千，從大軍迎擊。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year Galdan again invaded Khalkha as far as the Uldza River. The banner selected four thousand troops to join the main army in meeting the attack.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year, when Galdan again invaded Khalkha as far as the Uldza River, the banner sent four thousand troops to join the main army in repelling him.

sentences.zh: 復以所部索諾木伊嚕爾圖鄉導功，賜號達爾漢。

translations.literal: Sonom Iriltu of the banner was further granted the title Darhan for his service as guide.
translations.idiomatic: Sonom Iriltu of the banner was also granted the title Darhan for guiding the army.

sentences.zh: 五十四年，以災歉收，詔發唐三營儲粟賑之，復賜無產台吉牲牧。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year, because disaster caused poor harvests, an edict ordered grain from the Tang Sanying storehouses distributed in relief, and livestock was again granted to taijis without property.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fourth year disaster and crop failure prompted relief grain from the Tang Sanying storehouses, and destitute taijis were again given herds.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年，遣官齎銀賑所部貧戶。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongzheng, officials were dispatched bearing silver to relieve the poor households of the banner.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 2 officials were sent with silver to aid needy households under the banner.

sentences.zh: 九年，大軍剿噶爾丹策淩，檄兵駐達哩剛愛。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, when the main army suppressed Galdan Tseren, troops were mobilized by dispatch and stationed at Daligangai.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year troops were called up and posted at Daligangai for the campaign against Galdan Tseren.

sentences.zh: 十三年，撤還。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year they were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year they were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 所部二旗：右翼駐昌圖山，左翼駐烏勒扈陀羅海。

translations.literal: The tribe had two banners. The right wing was stationed at Changtu Mountain; the left wing at Ulehu Toronhai.
translations.idiomatic: The banner had two divisions: the right wing at Changtu Mountain and the left at Ulehu Toronhai.

sentences.zh: 爵二：扎薩克多羅貝勒一，扎薩克固山貝子一。

translations.literal: There were two ranks: one jasak duoluo beile and one jasak gushan beizi.
translations.idiomatic: There were two noble ranks: one jasak duoluo beile and one jasak banner beizi.

sentences.zh: 扎薩克貝子棟伊思喇布十傳至東林多爾濟。

translations.literal: Ten generations after jasak beizi Dong Israb came Donglin Dorji.
translations.idiomatic: The jasak beizi line passed from Dong Israb through ten generations to Donglin Dorji.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，以報效軍需，賜郡王銜，世襲貝勒。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuantong, for contributing military supplies, he was granted the designation of junwang, with hereditary beile rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 1 he was granted princely rank for supplying the army, with hereditary beile title.

sentences.zh: 左翼有佐領九，右翼有佐領七。

translations.literal: The left wing had nine zuolings; the right wing had seven zuolings.
translations.idiomatic: The left wing had nine zuolings and the right wing seven.

sentences.zh: 是部與烏珠穆沁、浩齊特、蘇尼特、阿巴噶四部合為十旗，統盟於錫林郭勒。

translations.literal: This tribe together with Ujumqin, Haoqite, Sunid, and Abaga — four tribes totaling ten banners — was united in a league at Xilin Gol.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Ujumqin, Haoqite, Sunid, and Abaga — ten banners in all — it formed the Xilin Gol League.

sentences.zh: 於內扎薩克東四盟中距京稍遠，風氣獨守舊，迄清季無招墾之事。

translations.literal: Among the four eastern leagues of Inner Jasak it was somewhat farther from the capital; its customs alone preserved the old ways, and down to the end of the Qing there were no land-reclamation projects.
translations.idiomatic: Of the four eastern Inner Jasak leagues it lay farthest from the capital; its people clung to old ways, and down to the end of the dynasty no land reclamation was ever undertaken.

sentences.zh: 察哈爾都統行文令辦新政，其盟覆文頗不遜。

translations.literal: The Chakhar banner general issued documents ordering the implementation of new policies; the league's reply was quite insubordinate.
translations.idiomatic: When the Chakhar banner general ordered the league to carry out the new policies, its reply was markedly defiant.

sentences.zh: 咸豐中，嘗徵其兵備防，旋以不得力，撤之。

translations.literal: During the Xianfeng reign its troops were once mobilized for defense, but they proved ineffective and were soon withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xianfeng era its troops were once called up for defense, but they proved useless and were soon withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 同治中，以回匪東竄，徵其盟駝只濟軍。

translations.literal: During the Tongzhi reign, because Hui bandits fled eastward, the league's camel corps was mobilized for campaign.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tongzhi era, when Hui rebels fled eastward, the league's camel corps was mobilized for service.
